articleTitle: Automatic Generation and Detection Method of LCD Samples Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: When the deep learning method is applied to the detection of microscopic defects with uneven brightness on the low-contrast LCD surface, due to the imbalance between the positive samples and negative samples when training the deep learning method, we propose a method to automatically generate samples based on a deep generative network model. First, a small number of defect samples are generated through a generative adversarial network to generate an expanded sample data set, and then the samples in these data sets are manually marked to highlight the defect parts, and the mask of the defect image is obtained for Mask R-CNN detection. The experimental results confirm that LCD image samples can be automatically generated by the proposed method, and the experiments on Mask R-CNN also confirm the effectiveness of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Application study of PointNet++ and hybrid filtering based point cloud denoising and segmentation algorithms for Blisk
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the process of collecting 3D point cloud data of aviation blisk, it is inevitable to collect various noise points and background point cloud data, which will affect the subsequent 3D reconstruction process. Therefore, how to extract the effective blisk point cloud information and retain the accurate structural features as much as possible is an important step in the preprocessing of the overall blisk 3D reconstruction. To this end, this paper proposes a hybrid filtering algorithm to denoise the single-view blisk point cloud data to remove noise. At the same time, the octree downsampling method is used to simplify the blisk point cloud data, which is beneficial to speed up the subsequent point cloud segmentation efficiency. The PointNet++ model is used to train labeled data to accurately extract blisk point cloud data. The experimental results show that the method can effectively segment the effective information of the whole blisk point cloud model, and the segmentation accuracy reaches 97.4893%.

articleTitle: WiFi-PDR indoor fusion positioning based on EKF
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that WiFi positioning technology is easily interfered by various factors in indoor positioning environment, and the cumulative error of pedestrian dead reckoning (PDR) technology based on inertial measurement unit (IMU) is large, this paper proposes a WiFi-PDR fusion positioning technology based on Extended Kalman Filter (EKF). In order to avoid the multipath effect of modeling with received signal strength (RSSI) data, offline database modeling is performed with channel state information (CSI) data. The collected CSI data are pre-processed with Hampel filtering and discrete wavelet transform (DWT) for noise reduction, and a WiFi location fingerprint database is established. On the basis of the peak value method, the double threshold method is added to detect the gait of pedestrians, and feedback adjustment is added to correct the heading angle online to improve the estimation accuracy of the pedestrian heading angle. The EKF algorithm is used to fuse the WiFi-PDR data, and a fusion positioning model is established to realize the real-time positioning of pedestrians. Experiments show that the positioning accuracy of the fusion positioning model proposed in this paper reaches 1.23m, which reduces the cumulative error of PDR positioning to a certain extent, and improves the accuracy and reliability of WiFi-PDR indoor positioning.

articleTitle: Multi-Level Rolling Horizon Planning and Scheduling Integrated with Material Constraints using DBR Approach: A Heuristic for Smart Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In recent years, industry 4.0 concepts have increased the trend of industries for digitization. In this situation, traditional planning and scheduling are no longer useful. Therefore, current research proposed multi-level planning and scheduling integrated with material constraints in rolling horizon periods. Current research utilized theory of constraints and Drum Buffer Rope (DBR) mechanism for multi-level planning and scheduling in mixed model production and proposed a multi-level planning heuristic (MLPH) using DBR and priority rules for efficient planning and scheduling considering material requirement planning and utilized capacity constraint resource (CCR) at maximum. The final compared results based on a real-world case indicate that the proposed multi-level planning heuristic outperforms the basic scheduling rules such as EDD, SPT and LPT.

articleTitle: SLAM for Firefighting Robots: A Review of Potential Solutions to Environmental Issues
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: As robotics continues to develop at an unprecedented rate, there is an increasing need to deploy robots to help humans in many fields, including firefighting areas. Firefighting robots are extremely useful in rescue work for various purposes, such as firefighting, transportation, exhaust, surveying, etc. Simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) technology may be used to provide an accurate map of the fire scene by firefighting robots. However, fire scenes are often filled with smoke and lack adequate lighting sources. Aiming to address some of the unfavorable conditions of fire scenes, this article reviews some solutions to similar problems in other fields and analyzes their characteristics from some previous publications on the SLAM technology for firefighting robots.

articleTitle: Human-Robot Collaboration Re-Manufacturing for Uncertain Disassembly in Retired Battery Recycling
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The production and sales of new energy vehicles has brought the recycling needs of retired Electric Vehicle (EV) battery for sustainable and green resource utilization. The purpose of this paper is to provide solutions for uncertain disassembly of EV battery in flexible production workshops. In this paper, a novel human-robot collaborative flexible re-manufacturing system is proposed to deal with the difficulties for the uncertain disassembly and re-manufacturing process of EV-battery recycling. The uncertainty in the disassembly process are analyzed to build the architecture of human-robot collaboration disassembly system. The D-H parameter method was used to analyze the kinematics of collaboration robot and its control system. The trajectory planning of collaboration robot is performed using the Rapidly-exploring Random Tree (RRT) algorithm. The neural network YOLOv7 algorithm is used to support the depth vision-based system to improve the recognition accuracy and motion accuracy for disassembly process.

articleTitle: Helmet Wearing Detection Using Improved Single Shot Multibox Detector
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In construction sites, safety accidents often occur because construction workers do not wear safety helmets. In order to detect whether construction workers wear safety helmets more timely and efficiently and reduce the incidence of safety accidents, we propose a safety helmet detection method based on a improved SSD algorithm. Our improved SSD algorithm uses four Feature Fusion Modules to fuse high-level features and low-level features to enhance the semantic information of low-level features and improve the ability of the algorithm to detect small-and medium-scale targets. The experimental results show that when the input size is 300, the mAP of our improved algorithm is 2.2 higher than that of the original SSD algorithm on the PASCAL VOC2007 dataset, the mAP is 1.8 higher on our own helmet dataset, and the detection speed is 51 frames per second. Our algorithm meets the real-time requirements of the helmet detection task, and has better detection performance.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Genetic Algorithm for Flexible Job Shop Scheduling Problem
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Partially flexible job shop scheduling problem (P-FJSP) is a NP Hard problem more complex than fully flexi-ble job shop scheduling problem (T -FJSP). In this paper, the mathematical model of flexible job shop scheduling is established with the goal of minimizing the maximum completion time (makespan). It combines the local search ability of simu-lated annealing algorithm and the global search ability of ge-netic algorithm. In the process of chromosome decoding, greedy decoding method is used to get a better scheduling solution as far as possible. The hybrid scheduling algorithm is implemented based on Visual Studio and C # language. Finally, 8×8 classic scheduling instance are used for simulation scheduling experiments to verify that the hybrid genetic algorithm proposed in this paper is effective in solving large-scale FJSP.

Author Keywords: hybrid simulated annealing and genetic algorithm

articleTitle: Enhancing Monte-Carlo Tree Search with Multi-Agent Deep Q-Network in Open Shop Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Production disruptions, e.g., machine breakdowns, cannot be predicted in any case. Such disruptions lead to a deviation of the planned and optimized production schedule, and the actual production process. Instead of manually re-routing products, an online scheduler can re-route products automatically and maintain the best possible production throughput. To establish such an online scheduler, a framework for combining Monte-Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) and a multi-agent Deep Q-Network (MADQN) to solve the Open Shop Scheduling Problem (OSSP) is developed. Similar to approaches of using some sort of single-agent to guide the MCTS during the exploration phase, this approach deploys a multi-agent. Although the combination of single agents and MCTS have shown promising results in relatively small environments, applications relying on this approach have a very limited number of use cases in a real production scenario due to the considerable number of machines and products [10]. However, for that particular use case, the multi-agents promise a scalable solution even for large environments [6]. To do so, the problem has to be formulated such that a multi-agent can solve it. In addition to that, a learning framework is presented, and the developed approach is compared to an MCTS and single-agent combination.

articleTitle: Research on Electric Vehicle DC Speed Regulation Based on PSO Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the field of transportation, new-energy vehicles have greatly promoted green and low-carbon development and have broad prospects. However, DC motors widely used in new energy vehicles still have difficulties determining control parameters in double closed-loop speed regulation, which may lead to unsatisfied control response. To aim at this problem, this paper proposes a PSO particle swarm optimization method to optimize the PID control parameters of the DC motor. Firstly, according to the non-linear and multi-variable characteristics of the brushless DC motor control system, we build the motor model then apply PID control theory based on the speed loop to realize the single closed-loop and double closed-loop speed control of the motor. Then, to improve the motor control effect and realize the self-tuning of PID parameters, the PSO particle swarm algorithm was introduced into the controller to tune the PID control parameters. After that, we use Simulink/Matlab to obtain the output curve and ITAE index of motor control before and after optimization and prove the improved self-tuning effect of the PSO particle swarm algorithm on PID parameters. Finally, we perform proteus simulation to complete the electric vehicle in different working conditions, such as high and low speed, acceleration-deceleration, and disturbance. The experimental results indicate the excellent engineering application value.

articleTitle: Demagnetization Fault Detection Research of Brushless DC Motor Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper presents a Brushless Direct Current Motors (BLDC) demagnetization fault diagnosis method based on machine learning. Firstly, the demagnetization fault mechanism of BLDC is analyzed, and the simulation model of the BLDC test bench is established. The radial mechanical vibration of BLDC with different demagnetization degrees is analyzed by finite element simulation. Then this paper designs reasonable experimental parameters according to the experimental design method, collects radial mechanical vibration data to form a data set, and utilizes the data set to train XGBoost, neural network, and convolutional neural network (CNN). During the training procedure, it is necessary to reasonably design the parameters such as network nodes and layers, optimize the network structure to upgrade the fault diagnosis performance, and then realize the diagnosis of BLDC random demagnetization fault.

articleTitle: A method for obtaining user requirements based on NLTK and knowledge graph
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The traditional product design scheme can no longer fully meet the current user needs. To solve some problems that live in the period of small and medium batch products' design in traditional solutions, such as long cycles and a lot of differences between design direction and user needs as well as the high technical difficulty of current deep learning-assisted products. This paper proposes a rapid update design method for small batch products based on a knowledge graph, combining data mining and Python module methods. This method aims to reasonably reduce technical requirements, obtain user comments with intelligent crawler plug-ins, complete the extraction of demand information with two key modules of NLTK and Stanford CoreNlp, and realize visualization with a knowledge graph.

articleTitle: Multistage Fusion Approach of Lidar and Camera for Vehicle-Infrastructure Cooperative Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: We propose VICOD, a multistage fusion approach of lidar and camera for vehicle-infrastructure cooperative object detection. The proposed network takes the vehicle-side point cloud and image data with the infrastructure-side point cloud data as inputs, after extracting features, the vehicle-side detection results were generated through the region proposal network and the second-stage detection network, and the infrastructure-side detection results were generated through the region proposal network and the detection head. The detection boxes fusion network performs the match and combination of the vehicle-side and infrastructure-side detection results to generate fused detection boxes, which improves detection accuracy and expands the sensing range of the vehicle side. We compare the results with the benchmark provided by the DAIR-V2X dataset [1] we used, which shows that our scheme significantly improves the average precision of vehicle-infrastructure cooperative object detection. Besides, because we use only point cloud data on the infrastructure side for late fusion, the infrastructure-to-vehicle data transmission cost and time delay will be lower compared to using vehicle-side and road-side sensors for early fusion and feature-level fusion.

articleTitle: Cassini Oval Scanning for High-Speed AFM Imaging
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Atomic force microscopy (AFM) generally scans the sample surface following a raster pattern signal, which contains discontinuities at turning points and frequencies beyond mechanical bandwidth of scanning stage. Consequently, raster scanning at high speed brings distortions to the resulting image. This paper describes a non-raster scanning method based on Cassini oval pattern. In this method, by adopting Cassini oval pattern, the input control signals of the two axes of scanner are replaced by sinusoid-like smooth signals, thereby reducing the harmonic vibration and improving scanning bandwidth. In addition, details on how to formulate the scanning pattern and generate the Cassini oval signals are analyzed. Experimental results of implementing this method in a commercial AFM and a compensated piezoelectric scanner indicate its feasibility on imaging.

articleTitle: An Improved SURF Algorithm with FREAK Descriptor for BGA Component Image Stitching
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper presents an image stitching method of BGA component for industrial operation. The mounter is the core equipment of the surface mount system, and it currently has no way to place components larger than the camera's field of view. Therefore, a high-speed image stitching method of BGA component is still not available. In this method, the hu invariant moment is used to determine the overlapping area of the image and reduce the range of feature point extraction. After obtaining the feature points, the differences between the SIFT (Scale Invariant Features Transform) algorithm, the SURF (Speeded Up Robust Features) algorithm and the improved SURF algorithm are compared. The improved SURF algorithm combines the SURF feature extraction method and the FREAK (Fast Retina Keypoint) descriptor is developed. After the feature points are processed by BFMather matching and RANSAC algorithm, the image transformation matrix of the two images is calculated. Finally, the perspective transformation is performed on the image to complete the image stitching. This image stitching method is shown to be simple and effective for high-speed industrial application. The procedure taken can be extended to other similar IC component and to other machine.

articleTitle: Improved RRT* path planning algorithm based on artificial potential field method
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of water environmental garbage cleaning, this paper based on RRT* planning algorithm, combined with artificial potential field method to improve the path planning algorithm, to achieve the obstacle avoidance path planning of cleaning equipment. In the process of water area garbage cleaning, the cleaning equipment not only needs to avoid obstacles, but also is affected by current resistance in the process of moving. Therefore, the resistance during the moving process of the cleaning device is denoted as the potential field partial repulsion force, and the potential field function is introduced into the algorithm sampling process, so as to solve the problems of blind node expansion and slow convergence rate of RRT* algorithm itself. In addition, the fixed step size in the sampling process is changed to the dynamic step size, which makes the path obtained by RRT* algorithm smoother. Finally, the simulation based on MA TLAB verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the improved algorithm.

articleTitle: Vision-driven High Precision Positioning Method for Bracket Assembly with Industrial Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The quality of the bracket assembly is an important guarantee for the successful launch of the rocket. The assembly accuracy of the bracket installed inside rockets is affected by bracket pose estimation, robot grasping, and positioning. We have proposed a recognition and pose estimation algorithm that integrates 2D and 3D vision to improve the bracket assembly accuracy. A position-based visual servo bracket grasping method is used to avoid the poor absolute positioning accuracy of the industrial robot. Then a small field-of-view vision system was established to achieve precise positioning of the bracket. We also developed a quick and precise hole detection algorithm based on YOLOv5 and caliper vision operator to compensate for the absolute positioning error of industrial robots. With the help of a vision servo grasping strategy and high precision re-positioning algorithm, the bracket's assembly hole positioning accuracy can finally reach 0.05mm. It is worth mentioning that the methods proposed in this paper have been successfully applied in the flexible automatic assembly line of the brackets used in rockets.

articleTitle: Review of Triboelectric Nanogenerators Applied to the Field of Intelligent Robotics
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, human beings have entered the information age, and the Internet of Things, which connects physical devices by collecting and communicating data, has also promoted the development of robotics. Robotics development has gradually entered an advanced stage. Reasonable robot morphology design and the ability to perceive contact information have been the research difficulties in the field of bionic robotics. Based on TENG can theoretically overcome the current difficulties of flexible robots in mapping and integration, and make up for the shortcomings of rigid robots in terms of workspace, task objects, and human-robot collaboration to meet the demands of increasingly complex tasks. This paper introduces the basic operating modes of triboelectric nanogenerators, lists some friction nanogenerator-based self-powered systems applicable to robots, and reviews some research on triboelectric nanogenerators being applied to bionic and soft robots. Finally, future research ideas prospect.

articleTitle: Multi-channel LSTM-CNN power load multi-step prediction based on feature fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to fully consider the influence of uncertain factors such as complex and changeable weather conditions and social events, a multi-channel LSTM-CNN (Long Short Term Memory-Convolutional Neural Network) power load multi-step forecasting model based on feature fusion is proposed for the first time, by modeling the sequential data with different time scales and using the neural network model composed of multiple LSTM networks in parallel, the multi-scale time feature representation is learned, the output time step of each LSTM is convoluted by CNN, and its output characteristics are extracted.

articleTitle: Clustering Analysis of User Load Characteristics under New Power System Based on Improved k-Means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the development of the Smart Grid, the new power demand side management (DSM) is further improved as an important part of smart grid functions, and it becomes increasingly important to clearly divide users with different power load characteristics. In this paper, K-means algorithm is used to cluster the user load characteristics users in Hunan Province. In addition, the determination of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$K$</tex> value in this algorithm is comprehensively discussed from the perspective of three cluster evaluation indexes, Calinski-Harabasz Index(CH), Davies-Bouldin Index (DBI) and Silhouette Coefficient. The specific classification results of 110kV voltage class users in Hunan Province based on load rate are obtained, which provides new guidance for cluster analysis and research based on user load characteristics.

articleTitle: A Fault Diagnosis Method for High-Speed Train Wheelset Bearings Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the traditional fault diagnosis method is difficult to effectively extract the fault features of the high-speed train wheelset bearing signal, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis method based on the two-dimensional image method. First, the one-dimensional vibration signal is converted into a Two-dimensional grayscale image, eliminating the influence of expert experience on the feature extraction process. Then an improved network model is proposed, which can automate the process of feature extraction and fault diagnosis. Finally, this paper simulates the complex driving environment of high-speed trains by adding noise with different SNRs to the vibration signal and analyzes the influence of noise on the diagnostic ability of the method. The results show that the method is effective.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional recognition method of fruit target based on PointNet++
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the conventional target recognition algorithm is highly dependent on light and has a poor fruit recognition effect in low light and dark environments, this paper proposes a three-dimensional fruit recognition method based on PointNet++. First, a depth camera is used to obtain point clouds to construct a dataset, and then the network is trained using the dataset. Finally, the fruit point cloud is recognized by the trained network. The experimental results show that the PointNet++ algorithm can recognize both unoccluded and partially occluded fruit point clouds, and the IoU of the predicted and real results are 0.92 and 0.89, respectively, which meets the actual production requirements.

articleTitle: Hydraulic System Principle and Common Fault Analysis of Hydraulic Press
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of science and technology, China's industrial demand for advanced equipment is increasing. As the main equipment of material forming, hydraulic press is widely used. In this paper, the working principle of the hydraulic system of high pressure and large flow hydraulic press is analyzed in detail, and the common fault phenomenon of the system is analyzed and the concrete improvement measures are put forward, which is of great significance to reduce and avoid the hydraulic fault and contribute to the better and more stable operation of the system.

Author Keywords: hydraulic press working principle fault analysis

articleTitle: Objective parameter balance control and optimization design of sound quality of rolling rotor compressor
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Based on the objective parameters of sound quality of the compressor, combined with the multi-objective optimization algorithm, this paper takes the thickness and size of the outer shell as the design variable, and proposes an objective parameter balance control evaluation function for sound quality, which provides a sound quality improvement method for rolling rotor compressors.

articleTitle: Design and Numerical Simulation of Vibration Isolation and Shock Resistance for the Electronic Equipment on the Rockets
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The severe mechanical environment faced by the electronic equipment on the rockets in its whole life cycle directly affects the electrical function, performance and reliability of the equipment. It is necessary to carry out vibration isolation and shock resistance design to improve the environmental adaptability of the equipment. Based on the practical experience, the basic design process of vibration isolation and shock resistance for military electronic equipment was proposed. An electronic equipment on the rockets was taken as the research object, the relevant design and numerical simulation of vibration isolation and shock resistance were carried out. Based on the brief introduction of its structure, the vibration isolation mode, the selection of vibration isolator and other design measures were discussed, and the numerical simulation was carried out with the finite element method. The results of numerical simulation and prototype test verified the effectiveness of the vibration isolation and shock resistance design measures. This provides reference for design and analysis of similar equipment.

Author Keywords: Design of Vibration Isolation and Shock Resistance

articleTitle: Industrial Operation Training Technology Based on Panoramic Image and Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Augmented reality training based on real scenes has problems such as hardware dependence and environment dependence, which makes most of the augmented reality complex industrial operation training unable to be carried out smoothly. In view of the above problems, this paper proposes an augmented reality complex industrial operation training method based on panoramic images. Based on panoramic images control technology, knowledge point mapping technology and training knowledge dynamic guidance technology, a complex industrial operation training system based on panoramic augmented reality has been formed. Based on wiring operation training, the feasibility of the technology and the effectiveness of the training effect have been verified. Compared with traditional training, This technology can effectively improve the training effect of complex industrial operations.

articleTitle: Design of Virtual Commissioning System for Intelligent Manufacturing Production Line Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problems that the product manufacturing process of intelligent production line is not intelligent enough and the on-site commissioning is costly, long and risky, a virtual commissioning system design scheme of intelligent production line oriented to digital twin is proposed. Firstly, a data- driven multi-dimensional fusion modeling method of digital twin is used to construct a multi-dimensional model of the digital twin of an smart production line; secondly, in order to improve the intelligence of the smart production line, a heuristic ant colony algorithm is proposed to optimize the allocation of cargo space in the automated three-dimensional warehouse; then, the communication mechanism and information interaction principle of the digital twin system of the smart production line are studied and analyzed; finally, the experiment proves that Finally, it is proved through experiments that the solution can reduce the risk of on-site commissioning of intelligent production line, shorten the commissioning time, and provide an effective solution for the intelligent enhancement and commissioning of intelligent production line.

articleTitle: Full life cycle carbon footprint assessment of circular saw blades based on design feature modelling
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to assess the carbon footprint of a saw blade throughout its life cycle, a new carbon footprint LCA assessment method applied to the conceptual design phase is proposed. In this paper, the concepts of product system features and individual features are proposed to describe the layer-by-layer constraint relationships between saw blade parts. A design feature-based representation model of a saw blade design solution is developed. The correlation between the whole-life carbon emissions of sawblades and design features is analyzed, a carbon footprint calculation method based on design features is proposed, and a sawblade whole-life carbon footprint assessment model is established. Taking a TC350 model saw blade as an example, the feasibility of the proposed method is verified by calculating and analyzing its whole-life carbon footprint.

articleTitle: Development of a New Testing System for Reliability Assessment of Hydraulic Cylinder
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at improving reliability of hydraulic cylinder and pertinent machine system, it is meaningful to promote reliability testing of the cylinder. In this work, a novel idea to organize reliability testing of hydraulic cylinder under normal or accelerated stress levels is proposed, the variable loading stresses applied include working pressure, velocity, side load and oil temperature of the cylinder. Modular design and development of the mechanical testing bench, the fluid power drive and control system with power recovery, and the computer-aided measurement and control system are implemented, with the integrated new testing system, an accelerated life test and prediction of reliability characteristics of an industrial hydraulic cylinder under normal stress level are successfully performed. The developed new testing system would provide an excellent test platform for hydraulic cylinder reliability assessment.

articleTitle: Distributed Optical Fiber Sensing Signal Recognition Based on Deep Residual Shrinkage Network
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Deep residual shrinkage network (DRSN) is proposed to enhance the recognition effect of distributed optical fiber sensing signals. The experimental data are collected by distributed optical fiber sensing perimeter security system in which six kinds of vibration signals are studied, including slapping, walking, rolling, noise, climbing and raining. The experimental results show that the recognition accuracy of DRSN method is higher than that of CNN and ResNet methods. The average test accuracy of DRSN method is up to 98.017%. Compared with ResNet method, the average test accuracy of DRSN method is improved by about 1.1 %. Compared with CNN method, the average test accuracy of DRSN method is improved by about 2.5%. Moreover, DRSN method is obviously superior to CNN and ResNet methods according to the evaluation indexes of precision, recall and F1-score.

articleTitle: Research on Low Frequency Vibration Reduction of Transformers Based on Particle Damping
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Taking a certain type of transformer as the research object, a solution based on particle damping is proposed for the problem that low-frequency vibration is difficult to control. Firstly, energy consumption model for transformer based on particle damping is established, and the optimal design parameters such as particle size and particle filling rate are determined by discreteelement method(DEM). Secondly, the transformer is modified and the damping effect is verified by experiment. The results show that when the vibration damping base adopts the design scheme of iron-based alloy particle 1 and iron-based alloy particle 2,particle size of 3mm and filling rate of 80%, the total acceleration effective reduction of the four measurement points are 66.67%, 53.09%, 66.23 % and 86% The solution is important to reduce the low frequency vibration of substation equipment.

articleTitle: Application of FMECA in Vehicle Reliability Analysis Based on Fuzzy Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Failure Mode, Effects, and Criticality Analysis (FMECA) is a commonly used method in vehicle reliability analysis. Aiming at the ambiguity and uncertainty existing in the fault hazard assessment, the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation was proposed to optimize the traditional FMECA. In the process of analysis, analytic hierarchy process and membership theory are used to analyze the influencing factors of failure mode to get the risk degree of every single failure mode to the whole system. Compared with the traditional FMECA method, the method proposed in this paper overcomes the defect of the analyst's subjective uncertainty, improves the rationality of the analysis result, and provides a more scientific basis for the reliability analysis of the product.

articleTitle: Polar Environment Monitoring Buoy Based on MSP430 MCU
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper plans to develop MSP430, using low-power wake-up technology, carrying sensors for real-time underwater temperature profile measurement and CT hydrological data collection, and develop an environmental monitoring buoy suitable for polar ice area. It has the capability of low power consumption and long endurance, and has the redundancy to choose to carry a variety of sensors. Relying on China's polar scientific investigation, the buoy successfully completed the field test, which is a beneficial attempt to innovate the polar ice area observation technology in China.

articleTitle: Combining the YOLOv5 and Grabcut Algorithms for Fashion Color Analysis of Clothing
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The analysis and prediction of apparel fashion colors are very important for the production and sales activities of the apparel industry. In the field of fashion color analysis of apparel images, existing image algorithms have problems such as poor segmentation effects in complex backgrounds and poor data real-time. In this paper, the YOLOv5 algorithm is applied to garment detection, the histogram equalization is used to enhance the image of garment pictures, the KMeans clustering algorithm is used to get the approximate foreground area of the garment, the GrabCut algorithm is used to segment the image with the processed pictures to get the final foreground color area of the garment, and then the KMeans clustering algorithm is used to get the main color of the garment. thus analyzing the pattern between colors. The study of fashionable colors of clothing in video surveillance scenes has higher real-time data volumes, larger data capacities, and faster analysis speeds than the current research methods.

articleTitle: Detection Method of Ore Particle Size Distribution Based on YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Traditional ore size detection algorithms are mainly machine vision-based ore image segmentation algorithms, which cannot meet the requirements of the industry in terms of accuracy and real-time. Therefore, this paper proposed a deep learning network model based on YOLOv5 for real-time detection of ore particle size. The location of the ore bounding box and its width and height information were output from the YOLOv5 network model, and then the FERET particle size of the ore was extracted. The cumulative error rate between the final particle size distribution detection results and the actual distribution was less than 3%, and the performance was good.

articleTitle: Collaborative robotic arm-based arc additive manufacturing system and part forming control study
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Wire and arc additive manufacturing (WAAM) is a process based on layer-by-layer stacking of additive models to manufacture parts. In this paper, an arc additive manufacturing experimental platform is built using a collaborative robotic arm, a welding machine, an industrial control machine and the upper computer software, which can realize the arc additive manufacturing of metal parts. The upper computer software can complete the slicing of additive parts, Gcode file parsing, and collaborative robotic arm and welder control. The simulation experiment platform built by the collaborative arm virtual machine can verify the consistency between the coordinate points of the layered slicing and the path points of the collaborative robotic arm, and can plan the additive path according to the demand. The frame parts completed by the arc additive manufacturing experimental platform have good molding effect and the dimensional error meets the requirements of the additive process. The research results can provide a reference for the collaborative robotic arm to realize arc additive manufacturing.

articleTitle: Path Planning and Tracking Control Method Based on Bessel Curve
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the process of path planning, in order to reduce the number of path points, will be a smooth line into line, driverless vehicles in the path of turning is not smooth, thus put forward a kind of based on Bessel path planning and tracking control method, through the establishment of unmanned vehicle kinematics model, mapping the coordinates of the current point of the vehicle into Bessel curve points, The line segment to be tracked by path tracking at the moment is calculated, so as to realize the smooth processing of turning path. The experimental results show that the actual route trajectory of the driverless vehicle is in good agreement with the theoretical route trajectory, so as to realize the smooth processing of the turning path of the driverless vehicle.

articleTitle: Morphological Construction of Transmission Error of Precision Reducer Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Transmission error is a key indicator to characterize the performance of precision reducer. The test result of transmission error will be influenced by input speed and load torque. In this study, a morphological construction method of transmission error of precision reducer based on BP neural network was proposed to obtain the morphology of transmission error under different input speeds and load torques. Then the transmission accuracy of precision reducer could be accurately evaluated. With RV-40E reducer as an example, the morphological structure of its transmission error was obtained. The experimental results demonstrate that the model established by the proposed method can reflect the morphology of transmission error.

articleTitle: Development of an Experimental Platform for 3-DOF Planar Parallel Robots
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In view of the problem of single function and insufficient extensibility of enclosed controller, the open planar 3-DOF (3-PRR) parallel robot control system of “PC+ Motion Control Card” is designed. The control software of parallel robot is written based on “Win-Form” development platform. It has the functions of initialization, single-axis motion, dual-axis motion, state monitoring and other main modules. In the end, the result show that the system has the characteristics of strong stability, high-accuracy trajectory and good openness through experimental analysis of the robot motion control, the control requirements of planar 3-PRR parallel robots under high speed, high acceleration and complex trajectory motion have realized.

articleTitle: Design of Automatic Loading Mechanism Based on PLC Control
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This design comprehensively uses the relevant knowledge of machinery, hydraulic pressure, electromechanical transmission, and PLC to design a set of small automatic loading mechanism that can complete automatic stick insertion. In order to reduce the labor intensity of workers and improve the workload of unit man hour, this paper designs the automatic feeding, transportation, loading and control device of the ice cream stick during the production of ice cream. The design mainly includes the mechanical transmission system, hydraulic system and PLC control system when inserting the ice cream stick into the mold. Finally, the following processes are automatically realized: the mold is sent to the designated position with a conveyor belt; The hydraulic device at the lower end lifts it to align with the distributor; Then use the conveyor belt to arrange the ice cream sticks orderly and transport them upward. The ice cream sticks are transported to another conveyor belt through the transition gear. When enough ice cream sticks are transported, stop feeding; The hydraulic devices on both sides of the conveyor belt push the blanking plate to push the ice cream stick into the distributor and then retract it. The ice cream stick is inserted into the lower mold orderly through the distributor; The mould with the rod loaded falls back to the conveyor belt through the hydraulic device and is transported away. The design content of this paper includes CAD design drawing, part drawing, hydraulic schematic diagram, PLC control sequence function diagram and the selection of main components. The designed equipment has the advantages of simple structure, convenient maintenance, low cost, high controllability and labor saving.

articleTitle: Intelligent Manufacturing Line Design Based on Parallel Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: After the transformation of the automatic production line, most of the traditional manufacturing factories adopt the serial processing method for production, which not only has insufficient resource scheduling and low production efficiency, but also requires a lot of manpower and material resources to be invested in the high cost of line change. Therefore, under the general trend of digital transformation, factories need a way of full resource scheduling, higher production efficiency and convenient line change. Firstly, with the goal of the shortest completion time of a single product, the specific steps of the process were analyzed, the layout of the production line was carried out, and the general parallel scheduling rules were extracted to establish the scheduling model of processing, assembly and quality inspection of a single product in MES system. Then, the layout and optimization of production line are carried out by the established model. Finally, the specific execution instructions are normalized, and a standard coding structure is proposed. Finally, the actual operation results show that the optimization rate of the optimized production line is 48.5%, which proves the superiority of the parallel cooperative scheduling model.

articleTitle: Colour selection for mosaic tiles based on FCM clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to solve the difficulty of tile color selection in mosaic tile field, establish a color recognition system to reduce color difference according to RGB color model, then use FCM clustering algorithm to determine the optimal new color scheme. Based on the constraints of expressiveness to find out 1~10 clustering centers to get the final required 10 color selection results.

articleTitle: Research on 3D LiDAR Point Cloud Matching Localization Method
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In 3D laser SLAM, the laser point cloud matching accuracy plays a decisive role in map building and localization. In order to better analyze the point cloud matching accuracy of LiDAR.In this paper, an experimental platform is built for two different point cloud matching algorithms commonly used, the nearest point iterative algorithm ICP and the normal distribution transform algorithm NDT. And the experiments are conducted in the experimental field to obtain the relative and absolute positional errors. The experimental results show that the localization accuracy of NDT is higher than that of ICP, and the robustness of NDT is significantly higher than that of ICP especially at the corner.

articleTitle: Design on wire cutting process of micro gear based on Opticam
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the extrusion process of micro gear, the micro gear mold has high machining accuracy requirements. The female die is more difficult to machine and the requirement of machining accuracy is more precise than the male die. In this thesis, using a wire cutting plug-in (Opticam) which can attach in NX UG, through the wire cutting process, a micro gear female die with 0.1 mm module and 10 number of teeth is successfully machined by <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$20\mu\mathrm{m}$</tex> tungsten wire in simulation module. Output the NC files and simulation parameters to actual machining tool, the outside diameter and the root diameter of finished product are both within the error range. Therefore, it is an effective and valid processing technology to use Opticam for wire cutting of micro gear mold.

articleTitle: A Self Developed Cooperative Manipulator and Its Zero Force Drag Control
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper designs a cooperative manipulator with integrated joints, introducing a friction identification method for zero force drag control of the manipulator. The mechanical structure of links and joints in the manipulator is designed by 3D design software. After processing and assembly, the precision and repeatability of the manipulator are tested by laser tracker. The Newton Euler method is used to establish the dynamic model of the manipulator, a method of joint back and forth motion is used to accurately identify the friction of each joint in the manipulator, and the least square method is used to fit, so as to compensate the friction of the motion control to achieve zero force dragging effect. Finally, drag experiments are conducted on each joint of the manipulator to verify the effectiveness of our work.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Paver Walking Hydraulic System Based on AMESim
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: According to the technical characteristics of the structure of road paving and crawler paver in China, the working principle of crawler paver hydraulic walking system is analyzed, and the walking hydraulic system of paver is designed and studied according to foreign design scheme. On the basis of establishing the actual working conditions of the paver, the hydraulic system components are selected, and the AMESim platform is used for the modeling and simulation of the two schemes. The simulation results show that the flow rate and the speed of the actuator are proportional to the valve port opening size. The required flow of the working loop does not have to do with the external load, but only with the area size of the multiplex valve opening. The motor port pressure and the motor flow is stable at 7.5 L/min under different slope conditions, indicating that this system is reliable and can provide reference for the innovative design of the hydraulic system of the paver walking mechanism.

articleTitle: Research on the Optimization of Production Line Based on the Value Stream Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper adopts lean thinking and value stream analysis method to analyze the M production line of N Company, find out the related factors that affect the cycle efficiency of M production line, analyze the main factors such as production line layout, field logistics, finished product inventory and quality status, find out the root cause of the problem and put forward the improvement plan. Flexsim software was used to model and simulate the proposed improvement scheme, and the feasibility of the scheme was verified. The practical application shows that the application of value stream analysis technology can shorten the production cycle and improve the production efficiency and benefit.

articleTitle: Research on Facial Expression Recognition Algorithm Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Expression is an important non-verbal means for human to express cognition and emotion. Facial expression recognition can not only be used to study human behavior and psychological characteristics, but also can be applied to many fields such as intelligent safe driving, medical treatment, distance education and so on. In this paper, the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), which is widely used, is studied and applied to facial expression recognition. In this study, a Network with small convolution kernel convolutional layer is built to make it applicable to facial expression recognition, and compare the expression recognition accuracy with a network structure built using a depth-separable convolutional layer, Batch Normalization and residual module, ResNet18 network and VGG19 network, borrowed from Xception Network. Based on Fer2013 and CK+ datasets, the network structure in this paper is used to compare the impact of whether to add the pooling layer, Batch Normalization, and different parameters such as epoch, optimizer, and whether to perform data enhancement on the accuracy of facial expression recognition.

articleTitle: Fully Automatic Double-arm Intelligent Crane
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In recent years, e-commerce has flourished, and logistics centers have sprung up quickly. The market requires cranes to be intelligent, lightweight, efficient, and automatic. As increasing order amount and high-intensity working environment appearing in logistics industry, it is necessary to innovate traditional cranes to meet the diverse market demands. The device includes four modules: the running module, the transfer module, the recognition and grasping module, and the control module. These four modules cooperate with each other to realize the precise movement, precise identification, efficient and accurate grasping. The project team has developed a new structure, which enables the crane to achieve a wide range of objects without moving left and right; at the same time, it can also achieve a wide range of stack points during stacking, which greatly improves its efficiency. In addition, the project team combines intelligent control with ingenious mechanical structure to realize the automatic operation and precise handling of the crane.

articleTitle: Design and Production of University Students' All Terrain Two Drive Baja Racing
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The “Baja Competition of China Society of Automotive Engineering” is a competition for off-road vehicle design, manufacturing and testing, which is organized by students from colleges and universities, vocational colleges and related majors. The Chinese Society of Automotive Engineering introduced the Baja competition to China in 2015 <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. At present, six competitions have been held, and the competition also adopts the combination of static competition and dynamic competition. Static projects include technical inspection, design defense and marketing defense. Dynamic items include climbing test, handling test and 4-hour endurance test. In this paper, the design and manufacturing process of small car racing is analyzed and explored, and the design and manufacturing process of two drive racing is summarized based on the author's experience and cases in the actual teaching process.

articleTitle: Optical encryption of gray image based on CS and CGH with double chaotic system
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this paper, a novel image encryption algorithm is proposed by combining Logistic chaotic map, 4D NHS hyperchaotic system, compressed sensing (CS), computer generated hologram (CGH) and two-dimensional discrete cosine transform (DCT). Firstly, the gray image is sparse represented by two-dimensional discrete cosine transform (DCT). The sparse matrix obtained by index sort scrambling is scrambled. For further encryption, the pixel scrambling uses the Logistic chaotic system to generate the scrambling vector. Subsequently, CGH encryption was performed and the Logistic chaotic map and 4D NHS hyperchaotic system were used as double keys to obtain the final encrypted picture.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Novel Soft Actuator with High Contraction Ratio Based on Nested Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Considering the drawbacks of existing soft actuators used in narrow unstructured space, such as lower expansion ratio and smaller driving force, a soft actuator with high stretch-draw ratio is designed in this paper. Based on TPU(Thermoplastic polyurethanes) airbags, the actuator is designed by the use of nested structure combined with rope mechanism, which achieves a large expansion ratio (115<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) on the premise of ensuring the rest size of the actuator. Then, according to the structural characteristics of the actuator, the static driving characteristics of TPU airbag and rope mechanism of the actuator are deduced by analytical and geometric methods. So the static model of output force of the actuator is obtained. Finally, a modeling method of using displacement-driven variable load instead of rope mechanism to construct simulation model is proposed. This research lays the foundation for the follow-up study of the actuator's dynamic characteristics and control strategy.

articleTitle: Design of MPM Based Information Structures of PLM System for Aerospace Mechatronic Servo System
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper takes aerospace mechatronic servo system as the study object, and proposes an information structure of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system based on Manufacturing Process Management (MPM). The introducing MPM system can integrate with Product Data Management (PDM) system and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)/ Manufacturing Execution System (MES) respectively. Based on Bill of Materials (BOMs), triple mapping relations of design information, process planning information and manufacturing information of aerospace mechatronic servo system can be established. The redesigned PLM system can improve the existing models and enable the integration of information and data throughout the product lifecycle from requirements, planning, design, process, production, etc.

articleTitle: Research on the Reliability Improvement Technology of Important Auxiliary Machines of Thermal Power Units Based on Deep Peaking
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: During the deep peaking, the important auxiliary machines of thermal power units operate in unconventional zones, and which seriously lack operational stability. This paper designs a reliability enhancement system for important auxiliary machines through data mining, artificial intelligence algorithms and adaptive control technology. The system can realize fault warning and fault self-healing under low load, and maintain the stability of main parameters of units. After testing and application verification, this technology can effectively improve the reliability of important auxiliary machines under deep peaking and reduce the invisible power generation loss. It can improve the economic efficiency of thermal power units and provide a reference for similar projects.

articleTitle: Research on Young's Modulus Prediction Model of Particle Reinforced Composites
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The Young's modulus prediction model of silastic matrix silicon carbide (SiC) particle reinforced composites is established by a three-dimensional two-phase representative volume unit model based on microscopic particle inclusion characteristics. Through the analysis of physical characteristics and spatial distribution characteristics of the particles in the composites, the representative volumetric unit model is proposed. Then, the effects of different particle parameters such as volume percentage, particle size fluctuation and particle size on the Young's modulus of silastic matrix SiC particle reinforced composites are analyzed. The simulation results show good agreement with the experimental measurements, which paves the way for the preparation of gradient functional materials with ideal distribution of Young's modulus on demand.

articleTitle: Observability Keeping in Observer Design of Descriptor System and Its Form
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the process of observer designing of descriptor systems, some system transformations are usually used to transform the descriptor systems into standard normal ones. However, some originally observable systems are not observable after these system transformations. For some standard normal systems with unknown interference, descriptor system form is also often constructed to design observers by using an augmented state vector. And the observability is also not always keeping in the latter transformations. The loss of observability will lead to a wrong observer, and usually it is inapparent. An extra constraint is added into the transformation matrices, and the observability can be guaranteed. Furthermore, the calculate process of the matrices is given. Two examples are shown to illustrate the correctness and the effectiveness of the presented methods.

articleTitle: Research on quality defect analysis and prediction model based on association rule mining
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: A quality defect analysis and prediction method based on association rule mining is proposed to address the coupling and ambiguity between multiple quality data in the process of product manufacturing quality control and diagnosis. It overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional quality defect analysis method which can only trace the quality from a single chain and can simultaneously analyze and predict the specific quality characteristics data that lead to the output quality defects and the multiple input parameters of the manufacturing process that have an impact on it. By dividing the quality characteristics data intervals through K-means and using the Apriori algorithm to explore the correlation between the quality characteristics data, we can construct the rules to judge the loss of product quality. A GA-SVR based manufacturing process quality defect prediction model is built using the cloud server plus local terminal technology structure. Finally, through example analysis, it is proved the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Structure Optimization and Internal flow of Cyclone in Catalytic Cracking Device
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The third stage cyclone (TTS) in the catalytic cracking device is the pivotal part to separate and recover catalyst particles, and it can ensure the normal operation of follow-up process. Internal flow patterns in it are particularly important for the selection and use of the equipment. In this paper, the structure parameters of the PV third stage cyclone of 2.8 million tons/year catalytic cracking device in a chemical plant are determined. Simulation of the turbulent 3D flow has been done with Reynolds stress model (RSM) and discrete phase model (DPM). Velocity and pressure drop patterns in the cyclone, effects of the inlet duct dimension on the separation performance and pressure drop, and the motion and separation efficiency of different diameter particles were analyzed. The results indicate that the flow field inside the cyclone forms a typical Rankin vortex flow pattern, and simulated pressure drops agree well with experimental results, which validates the numerical simulation method. When the inlet area is unchanged, the separation efficiencies first increase and then decrease with the increase of inlet height, and the optimal ratio of inlet height to cyclone's body diameter is 0.58. The migration trajectory of small particles have great randomness, and they are easy to escape from the vortex finder affected by the gas flow. The large particles rotate along the relatively large diameter and can be separated well. These results can provide the reference for the flow mechanism analysis and the industrial application of TTS.

articleTitle: Research on Manufacturing Quality Control Method Based on the Probabilistic Intuitionistic Fuzzy Set Prediction Model and the Triple Exponentially Weighted Moving Average Control Chart
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: To address the problem of late warning time of control charts, this paper proposes a method for manufacturing quality control by combining the PIFS-PSNN prediction model with the TEWMA control chart. The method can do pre-alert and is capable of dealing with various uncertainties and ambiguities in the data during the manufacturing process as well as detecting minor shifts in quality characteristics. The fuzzy time series prediction model is employed to predict the manufacturing quality characteristics data and build the control chart based on the predicted data, to detect the shift in the quality characteristics data earlier and feedback to the manufacturing process. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated by a case study.

Author Keywords: Triple exponentially weighted moving average control chart

articleTitle: An Improving NARX Multi-step Prediction Model for Ship Lifting and Sinking Motion
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: For the long sampling period of sensors on ships and compensation system time lag, a multi-step prediction of the ship's lifting and sinking motion is carried out to improve the control effect of the compensator and reduce the impact of wave interference on the operating equipment. To improve the stability and safety of the operating equipment, an improving NARX multistep prediction model is designed, while the common NARX multistep prediction model had the characteristics of error accumulation and low prediction accuracy. The improving model uses a fixed number of steps for iterative prediction to obtain multiple predicted values at the same moment, which is used to design a correction function to reduce the prediction error at each step, thus suppressing the accumulation of errors caused by multiple steps. And a multi-sea state model is established for validation. The simulation results show that the model performance of the improving NARX multi-step prediction method is better than that of the common NARX multi-step prediction method, and has stronger environmental adaptability and stability under multiple sea states.

articleTitle: Extraction of key geometric errors of a precision cylindrical grinder based on improved Sobol method
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to enhance the precision of metal rolling production, it is necessary to ensure the grinding accuracy of the cylindrical grinder. Since geometric errors constitute the primary factor that causes machine inaccuracies, the sensitivity analysis is carried out to extract the key geometric errors. The volumetric model of the grinder with 29 geometric errors is constructed by applying the homogeneous transfer matrix (HTM) and multi-body system (MBS) theory. This paper presents an improved Sobol method based on quasi-random set for performing the global sensitivity analysis (GSA). A simulation of error compensation is conducted to verify the analysis results. The key geometric errors extracted will serve as important guides for future error compensation.

articleTitle: Tolerance analysis and allocation of precision rotary table based on Jacobian-Torsor statistical model
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Numerical control(NC) rotary table is the core part of the machining center. Due to the existence of multi-source deviation and multi-point assembly of the same part in the assembly of the rotary table, the tolerance chains are more complex, and the assembly result depends on workers to correct during installation at site, resulting in low efficiency and low assembly accuracy. A three-dimensional tolerance modeling method was established based on the Jacobian-Torsor theory. A parallel assembly model was established under multi-point assembly, and the relationship between various deviation sources and assembly deviations is obtained. The contribution of each dimension chain error to the total error is obtained by Monte Carlo analysis, which provides a basis for the designer to allocate tolerance. After several times of iteration procedure, the calculated FR meets the threshold required for product assembly. This method can effectively improve the efficiency of assembly.

articleTitle: Design and Verification of Thermal Balance System for Electric Drive Transmission in Urban Public Transit
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the stable and reliable operation of the Electric drive transmission needs to maintain the thermal balance of the transmission, this paper studies the cooling demand of the urban bus deep hybrid power, and designs the cooling system to meet its requirements, testing the heating power under three limiting conditions, and then matches the corresponding cooler according to the heating power. The thermal balance test is carried out by carrying the transmission to the whole vehicle. The test results show that after the transmission reaches the thermal balance, the motor and oil maintain the appropriate and stable temperature.

articleTitle: Adaptive Controller for Synchronous Motion Control of Hydraulic Vibration Hammer
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Hydraulic vibration hammer is an important mechanical equipment in pile foundation engineering. In traditional hydraulic vibration hammer, the synchronous movement process is controlled by the mechanical system, which leads to the loss of energy transmission and the reduction of pile driving efficiency. In order to improve the synchronization accuracy of vibration hammer without mechanical synchronization mechanism, an adaptive PID synchronization control strategy based on BP neural network was proposed. Established the model of hydraulic transmission system, and the feasibility of BP-PID control strategy is verified by Simulink. A physical experimental platform of hydraulic pile hammer control system is constructed, and the experimental results show that the maximum synchronous speed error is reduced by 42.48% after control.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Digital Twin System for Hybrid Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Based on the digital twin technology, this paper studies the mechanism modeling and monitoring method of a five degrees of freedom hybrid robot, establishes the forward and inverse kinematics models of the robot by using the intermediate parameter method, analyzes the end error by introducing the idea of kinematic equivalent chain, and proposes to extract the flutter characteristics based on the variational mode decomposition. Application modules are designed to monitor the working state of the robot.

articleTitle: Research on Monitoring and Early Warning of Substation Geological Subsidence Based on High-Precision Beidou Positioning
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The geological subsidence of substations is sudden and complex, and its rapid and accurate monitoring and early warning is of great significance to the safe and stable operation of the power system. This paper presents a method for monitoring the geological subsidence of substations with high-precision Beidou positioning technology. On the one hand, it can optimize the PTK technology, and on the other hand, it can comprehensively process the data of the reference station and monitoring station and use the reference station as a reference to grasp and understand. The deformation of monitoring points ensures the accuracy of monitoring. In this paper, the output of pseudorange, carrier phase and other information of high-precision Beidou satellites is used to meet the requirements of positioning solution. Secondly, the principle of vertical and horizontal displacement monitoring of geology substations of high-precision Beidou satellite receivers is given. Finally, the settlement is given. The selection principle of monitoring base station, monitoring station and communication network. The high-precision Beidou positioning monitoring method proposed in this paper can quickly, real-timely, and accurately monitor and warn the geological subsidence of substations, changing the previous situation of manual monitoring of geological subsidence.

articleTitle: Development of Small Intelligent Production Line for Cylinder Liner
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Taking the cylinder liner as the carrier, a small intelligent production line integrating production and teaching has been developed. Intelligent and unmanned processing was realized through modules such as turning-milling compound machining center, stereoscopic warehouse, material conveying system, automatic loading and unloading system, and automatic detection and monitoring system. This paper introduced the mechanical structure of the stereoscopic warehouse and the automatic loading and unloading system of the production line and the software and hardware structure of the PLC control system in detail. Through on-site debugging and small batch production, the production line has reached the design expectations and better serves teaching and production.

articleTitle: A Closed Loop Quality Control System Based on Online Measurement Technology for Aviation Complex Component Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Increasing demand for quality control for complex component manufacturing in the aviation industry calls for the development of an automated integrated inspection system. Online measurement technology can solve the problem of high labor consumption and low efficiency of traditional inspection mode. To build a complete online measurement-based framework for component inspection in the aviation industry, an automatic path planning strategy integrated with an error evaluation and compensation framework was put forward in this article. Detailed planning steps and transformation relationships between each segment are discussed to reach a closed-loop workflow consequently. With the help of CATIA secondary development technology and the J2EE platform, an application system containing multi functions in the process of inspection activity was developed. In the end, the proposed system was put into use in a helicopter factory to expound the practicability and effectiveness of the methodologies.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Objective Resource-constrained Project Scheduling Problem Based on Improved NSGA-II Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: As the complexity of engineering projects increases, companies urgently need project scheduling methods that are more in line with actual conditions. On the basis of meeting project deadlines, activity procedures, and resource constraints, the company simultaneously pursues multi-objective collaborative optimization such as maximum benefit and resource balance. In this study, the classic resource-constrained project scheduling problem was expanded into a multi-objective and multi-mode resource-constrained project scheduling problem with the project's net present value maximization-resource balance as the optimization index. And the feasibility and effectiveness of the improved NSGA-II algorithm that introduces the optimal front-end individual coefficient in solving such problems was verified.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis and Maintenance Techniques for Hydraulic System of Common Construction Machinery
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The application of construction machinery is an important technical condition to ensure the development of industrialization. The stability of its equipment operation is a necessary condition to maintain industrial production efficiency. In the application of construction machinery, the use of hydraulic system is more frequent, because the hydraulic system in the long-term use often appear various problems, which needs to strengthen the fault diagnosis and maintenance technology of the hydraulic system of construction machinery, in order to make it in a good working state.
