This paper introduces the working characteristics and fault types of hydraulic system of construction machinery, lists the diagnosis methods of hydraulic system fault, and puts forward the specific application of hydraulic system fault maintenance technology.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of super BOM based on dynamic library table
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the product lifecycle, there exist multi-view Boms for different departments and functions. Each department in the custom when the BOM is not a unified specification design and management, and for different products of different enterprise each department involved in custom BOM. BOM attribute column is also a dynamic variable, most enterprises for BOM custom is still adopt the way of print before the department and the department of information sharing. Therefore, this paper proposes a concept of super BOM table, which can dynamically generate each business BOM table to meet the customization requirements of each department for BOM table. In addition, this paper also designs a super BOM creation platform based on B/S architecture to realize the paperless management of BOM., and proposes a new database access development mode for dynamic table building behavior. The last part of the article takes the machine tool product of A company as an example to test the related functions of the web platform. Practice has proved that the design and implementation of super-BOM based on dynamic library table makes the way of customized BOM more standardized and convenient, realizes the paperless management of BOM information, and greatly improves the management level of BOM table in enterprises.

articleTitle: A Reinforcement Learning Method for Inventory Control Under State-based Stochastic Demand
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the development of intelligent manufacturing, managers increasingly realize that to improve the efficiency of production, we should not only improve the level of manufacturing technology, but also enhance the ability of supply chain management. In supply chain management, inventory control is always essential but troubling. Because the formulation of the optimal strategy in different inventory scenarios is very complicated, the model in the literature often makes compromise when compared to the reality. This paper deals with the non-stationary demand considering the impact of promotion and seasonal factors. Specifically, the paper constructs an open-AI gym environment for inventory control problems with state-based demand, and proposes a complete modeling method. A reinforcement learning method based on SARSA is developed to solve the problem. We conduct a series of numerical experiments, which provide guidance for the selection of the hyper-parameter <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\varepsilon$</tex>, and confirm the ability of reinforcement learning to capture the unknown potential demand changes in the environment. Finally, some suggestions are drawn on how to deploy reinforcement learning in real inventory scenarios.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Electro-Hydraulic Servo Valve Based on Multilayer Perceptron
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The electro-hydraulic servo valve is the core component of the hydraulic system, so the electro-hydraulic servo valve is the key object in the maintenance process of the hydraulic system. Therefore, it is very important to study the fault of electro-hydraulic servo valve. Set up an experimental platform to measure the data under 3MP, 3.5MP, 4MP, 4.5MP and 5MP. After analysis and tradeoff, it was finally decided to use Adam, Momentum and RAdam optimization algorithms to realize the fault diagnosis of electro hydraulic servo valve. The data are organized into 37 dimensional arrays as samples for training. The first 32 dimensions are the characteristic parameters of the electro-hydraulic servo valve, and the last 5 dimensions correspond to five fault modes. The test set is 32 dimensions, and the diagnosis result is 5 dimensions corresponding to a fault mode. The diagnosis result is in line with expectations.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of influencing factors on corn Silage machine throwing effect based on EDEM
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the development of animal husbandry, the demand for corn silage has been significantly increased, as well as the requirement for its quality. The optimum harvest period of silage corn is short. To achieve timely harvest, high harvest efficiency must be ensured, which determines the necessity of mechanized harvest of silage corn. One of the key technologies of silage harvester is throwing technology, which provides certain theoretical basis for subsequent research on silage harvester technology in order to improve throwing performance. This paper takes the throwing device in horizontal cutting and throwing mechanism as an example to analyze the stress of corn straw and the influencing factors of throwing speed in the device. EDEM software is used to simulate the throwing process. With the particle throwing speed as the test target and the throwing speed, blade number and blade inclination as the test factors, the simulation test analysis is carried out, and the regression model is established and the model optimization is carried out. The results show that there is no obvious rule that the backward angle of throwing blade has influence on the throwing speed. The throwing speed increases with the increase of speed and number of blades.

articleTitle: Model-Free Predictive Current Control of Virtual Infinite Capacitors
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The virtual infinite capacitor (VIC) control method based on mathematical model will increase the output voltage ripple when the converter parameters are inaccurate. Based on this, this paper proposes an algebraic estimation method of predictive control combined with a first-order hyperlocal model. Through the real-time update of the hyperlocal model controlled system, the uncertainty and disturbance of the system are estimated, and a model-free predictive current controller is established. The duty cycle control signal is generated to improve the response speed of the current loop, and the voltage outer loop uses a PI controller to adjust the output voltage. The comparative simulation is carried out in the background of power factor correction (PFC), and the simulation results show that the control strategy can overcome the dependence of the controller on the system parameters, and can achieve better dynamic control performance and steady-state operation performance.

articleTitle: Improved Kernel Fuzzy C-Means Clustering Method Based on Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The improved kernel fuzzy clustering method is used to classify the load data of the smart grid accurately. It lays a good foundation for the subsequent work of power load forecasting and provides a more efficient, safe, and reliable direction for the operation of the power system. Firstly, the collected power load data is preprocessed to reduce data redundancy and improve data quality. Secondly, the kernel fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm based on particle swarm optimization is used to cluster the load data with the same power consumption characteristics. Finally, the improved kernel fuzzy clustering method is compared with the fuzzy C-means clustering method through a simulation example to verify the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Shoveling Trajectory Tracking Control of Loader Working Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Autonomous shoveling of loaders is the key technology to realize automatic and intelligent operation. Tracking control for target trajectory during shoveling is one of its core technologies. The actual motion trajectory of bucket in the pile directly affects the production, resistance force and energy consumption of the shoveling operation, so it is of great significance to achieve high-precision tracking control. Traditional PID control method has problems such as overshoot. To solve these problems, this paper first establishes a kinematic model of the working mechanism in drive space, then introduces the preview control method, combines PID with preview control, and designs a PID controller with preview distance based on kinematic decoupling, which improves the control performance by judging the future trajectory information in advance. The ADAMS/Simulink co-simulation shows that compared with traditional PID, the PID controller with preview distance improves the overshoot of bucket during steering and reduces the displacement error and angle error of bucket during tracking. Therefore, PID control with preview distance can comprehensively improve the control performance of traditional PID. In addition, it is found that how to choose a suitable preview distance is also a key factor to be considered in future work.

articleTitle: Pressure Balanced Regulation of Dual Common Rail Injection System by Neural Network Structural PID
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: To meet the demand of higher fuel injection performance in heavy duty diesel engine, high pressure dual common rail system (HPDCRS) suitable to heavy duty diesel engine is presented, pressure balance valve (PBV) is used to connect dual common rail, dual PID control is presented to control dual rail pressure by pressure control valve (PCV) and PBV, a neural network structural PID (NNS-PID) is introduced to perform coefficient tuning of PID automatically, simulation model of pressure control is founded in MATLAB/Simulink environment, pressure control calculation of dual common rail in the different target pressure is made. The results shown that PCV PID control can rapidly trace different target pressure, PBV PID control effetely decrease pressure difference between the two common rails, balanced regulation on common rail pressure of dual common rail injection system is feasible.

articleTitle: Intelligent Car Production Based on Single-chip Microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper mainly introduces the design and manufacture of an intelligent car with gyroscope orientation and automatic obstacle avoidance function; The vehicle is driven by DC motor and its control circuit, STC89C52RC single-chip microcomputer is the control core of the system, and MPU6050 six-axis gyroscope module is used to control the motor speed so that the car can drive according to the established line, and the infrared module is used to avoid obstacles automatically.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Manufacturing of Automobile Production Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper mainly introduces the following aspects: the current situation of intelligent manufacturing in automobile production, the system of intelligent manufacturing and the composition of intelligent manufacturing system for automobile production, the structural design of automobile intelligent manufacturing network, the research of automobile manufacturing positioning system and the design points of UWB positioning system, and the implementation method of automotive intelligent manufacturing big data analysis.

articleTitle: Development of Pipe Bending Machine Detection System Software Based on C++ and Java
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Pipe bending machine accuracy testing requires complex operation of supporting software using different instruments, in order to integrate the functions of multiple detection instruments into one software to simplify operation, a pipe bending machine detection system based on C++ and Java is developed. The system needs to read the instrument test data, instrument manufacturers only provide C++ development kit, Java has advantages in application development, so use joint programming, solving C++ and Java data transfer problems with Socket communication, realization of pipe bending machine detection system. Compared to traditional detection methods, the system aggregates functions into one system, reduce the cumbersome operation between processes. Select a measurement item as an example to test, prove easy operation of the whole system, simplify the inspection process, effective auxiliary testing personnel testing, It provides convenience for precision detection of pipe bender.

articleTitle: Maintenance Importance Model of CNC Machine Tools Based on Natvig Importance
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper discuss the application of maintainability importance analysis on the CNC machine tools on the basis of the maintainability model of CNC machine tools According to the characteristics of CNC machine tool repairable system, Natvig importance is introduced into the importance analysis of CNC machine tool. The maintainability models of CNC machine tool is established. The Natvig importance of maintainability model and probability importance of maintainability model are established, and the main parameters of the model are calculated. The bar chart of maintainability importance of each subsystem is obtained. At last, the importance sorting results of critical components conform to realities. Further the results could guide maintainability design, maintainability prediction and maintainability distribution.

articleTitle: Design of a cut tobacco volume flow detection system based on bulkscan lms511
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper mainly introduces the application of a cut tobacco volume flow detection system based on bulkscan lms511 in the tobacco industry. First, bulkscan lms511 identifies and marks the installation space location information through self-learning algorithm; Then, the cross-sectional feature information such as the height, width and angle of the conveyor belt is extracted and analyzed; Finally, according to the extracted characteristic information, combined with the encoder signal, the instantaneous / cumulative volume flow of conveying cut tobacco can be calculated, and then combined with the cut tobacco density value, the instantaneous / cumulative mass flow of cut tobacco can be calculated indirectly. The measurement error range is 1.11 %-1.48%, and the average error value is 1.29%. The detection system has the characteristics of high precision and high reliability. Based on this platform, more research topics can be carried out. For example, through the PID closed-loop control system to regulate the running speed of the bottom belt of the storage cabinet, it can indirectly control the flow of cut tobacco and improve the continuity and stability of the feed flow.

articleTitle: Safety Monitoring of Mooring Bollard Structure Based on Optical Fiber Sensing Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The existing methods based on monitoring mooring force cannot fully satisfy the needs of bollard structural safety monitoring under complex mooring conditions. Therefore, this article proposes a new monitoring method embarked on the mooring bollard structural characteristics. Firstly, the relationship between mooring bollards force and surface maximum strain is deduced. Secondly, the most unfavorable mooring condition which maximizes the surface stress of mooring bollard under the same mooring force is found. Finally, a method of mooring bollard structural safety assessment is proposed which takes the maximum strain obtained under the most unfavorable mooring conditions as the threshold value. Taking the case of 550KN cast iron bollard with single eave, distributed optical fiber sensing technology based on Optical Frequency Domain Reflectometer (OFDR) is used to implement fully distributed strain monitoring at the root of the bollard, and the monitored strain value is compared with the threshold value to decide the structural safety of the mooring bollard. This method uses optical fiber as sensing technology and strain value as evaluation index, which has strong accuracy and operability, and provides a new perspective for structural safety monitoring of mooring bollard.

articleTitle: On-line comprehensive measurement method and system for taper thread of pipe in non - contact
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Traditional measurement method is difficult to implement automatic and parametric online measurement of threads, which restricts the automatic and intelligent production of threaded workpieces. In order to realize automatic and parametric on-line testing of drill pipe taper thread, a non-contact taper thread comprehensive system for the pipe was developed. The measurement method of taper thread and the data processing method in the system was studied. Based on spectral confocal principle, the measuring method of taper thread profile scanning was proposed. It was analyzed that the error of measurement principle is negligible due to the difference between the central axis of thread and the workpiece axis. The thread central axis was determined by scanning the thread stop. To gain the thread contour curve, two generatrices that pass through the central axis of a thread were scanned by the sensor. Due to the abnormal data collected by the sensor, the capability gage of the system was low, a data processing algorithm based on mathematical model matching of curves was developed, and the curves was piecewise fitted by least square method. The experimental results showed that the short range sensor and large pitch taper thread contour scanning measurement method can achieve high precision, high efficiency and comprehensive measurement of box thread. The capability gage (Cg) of the system is less than 0.006mm, capability gage index (Cgk) is less than 0.03mm, gauge repeatability & reproducibility (GR&R) is less than 5% of the workpiece tolerance. It can meet production demand and solve industry technical problem that the optical measurement method is difficult to realize the thread contour scanning measurement, especially the sweep measurement of internal thread contour.

articleTitle: The Structure Stiffness Optimization Design and Test of a Satellite
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The main structure of a satellite using the traditional size method can not meet the rocket stiffness requirement, the structure stiffness optimization for the satellite were performed with the Patran/Nastran and the test. The optimized structure was analyzed and verified by the test. The results show that: 1)The mass of the optimized structure is almost unchanged, while the main structure stiffness is increased by 30%, reaching 59.87Hz, which is basically consistent with the theoretical analysis value of 57.03Hz, and meets the rocket stiffness requirement which is not less than 55.0Hz; 2) the optimized structure successfully has passed the static load examination of 2.5 times the appraisal level, and achieved the expects design value; 3) The optimized structure vibration response is basically consistent with the theoretical analysis value, and meets the requirement that the satellite structure response should be less than 20g; 4) The high stiffness and strength characteristic of satellite is achieved, has been passed the ground test and launched successfully. The process and outcome of the optimization is useful for structure design of the same type satellite in future.

articleTitle: Digital Precision Assembly Technology of Piston Accumulator Sealing Pair
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this paper, a digital precision assembly method is proposed to solve the problem that the assembly quality of piston accumulator sealing pair is not controllable. To solve this problem, the assembly-force prediction model of the sealing structures was established, and a finite element nonlinear simulation method was adopted to simulate the assembly process of the sealing pair. The influence of friction coefficient, tolerances and other factors on the assembly-force was analyzed by combining simulation and practical application, and the envelope range of the assembly-force curves of the X-shape sealing ring and the polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) retaining ring was obtained under various influencing factors. By comparing the quantified assembly-force collected in the actual assembly process of automated press-fitting equipment and the envelope range, the assembly quality of the sealing structure in the assembly process can be judged in real-time.

articleTitle: Random Vibration Fatigue Analysis and Structure Optimization of an Airborne Power Supply Unit
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The structural design of airborne electronic equipment should meet the fatigue life requirements under long-time random vibration. The finite element simulation method can accurately predict the fatigue life distribution of the structure in the vibration environment, and optimize the weak areas of the structure, which can effectively improve the success rate of the first design. In this paper, based on the frequency domain fatigue analysis method, combined with Miner's linear cumulative damage theory and material S- N curve, the fatigue life analysis of an airborne power supply unit under random vibration is carried out, and the results are in good agreement with the test. The fatigue failure mechanism is analyzed, and the structure is optimized, which effectively improves the fatigue failure resistance of the structure.

articleTitle: Target Tracking Method for Visual Autonomous Localization of Demolition Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: To solve the problem of autonomous and precise positioning of the robot arm in the non-structural environment of the demolition robot, binocular vision is used for the measurement of the target point for robot arm positioning, and the real-time tracking and measurement of the end of the robot arm during the positioning process. For demolition robots operating in non-structural environments, their tracking process will have the problems of randomly appearing tracking targets being obscured and a complex background environment. The paper solves this problem by extending the Camshift algorithm to 3D space, using depth information to separate occluders and targets in space. Through experiments, it is proved that this method can effectively solve the problem that the tracking of the end of the robotic arm is lost due to random occlusions during the positioning and tracking of the end of the robotic arm, so as to provide the feedback information of the spatial position of the end of the robotic arm for the autonomous positioning of the robotic arm in a real-time and stable manner.

articleTitle: Design of WMS for Digital Flexible Production Line of Aerospace Mechatronic Servo System
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this paper, the aerospace mechatronic servo system's digital flexible production line is taken as the study object, and the demand for automated Warehouse Management System (WMS) is proposed. By optimizing the existing process flow and improving the digital flexible production line, WMS can integrate with Manufacturing Execution System (MES) and Warehouse Control System (WCS) respectively. An integrated MES architecture of aerospace mechatronic servo system's digital flexible production line based on automated WMS is proposed.

articleTitle: Scheme Design and Verification of Heavy-duty Universal Launch Base under Strong Constraints
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of “The base must be replaced for cartridge replacement” caused by the difference of cartridge length in the current general launch system, this paper proposes an adjustable base which can realize two state height switching and self-locking in a narrow space under the constraint of limited launch compartment space and strong launch recoil force. The key structural parameters are obtained through mechanical analysis, the multi-body dynamics model is established based on Pro/E, the kinematics performance is analyzed based on the virtual displacement principle, and the kinematics and dynamics simulation is verified through ADAMS. Finally, the load performance of the adjustable base is verified through HyperMesh. The results show that the adjustable base proposed in this paper can meet the installation and launch requirements of two types of multi type cartridge, greatly improving the versatility of the launch system and the convenience of adding multi type weapons to ships.

articleTitle: Multi-party Secure Privacy Computation Based on Secrecy Coding
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this work, we propose a secrecy coding enabled multi-party secure privacy computation method, and the data of the multi participants can be used without harming the data privacy. By coding the secrecy data into secrecy vectors, the secrecy comparison between two parties can be converted to the partial scalar product problem of the secrecy vectors. Based on this design, we formulate the Millionaire and Relative Prime problems using the proposed secrecy coding. The security of the proposed method is guaranteed by selecting a random number locally at the multi users. Analysis shows that the proposed secrecy coding enabled multi-party secure privacy computation is lightweight and efficient.

articleTitle: Weld Seam Identification and Calibration Method of Spiral Steel Pipe Grinding Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The identification and calibration of weld seam is the key to solve the problem of low efficiency and low quality in weld grinding of spiral welded steel pipe. For the identification of internal and external weld seams of spiral welded steel pipes, this paper proposes three weld seam identification methods, which are respectively based on the sum of squares of residuals (RSS), template matching and segmentation search; In addition, aiming at the calibration of the feature points of the weld, this paper proposes the farthest distance method and slope analysis method to calibrate the left and right inflection points of the weld. The experimental results show that the three weld seam identification methods can accurately identify the relative position of the laser profiler and the weld seam. The weld seam calibration method can enable the feature points to be accurately identified and calibrated, guaranteeing subsequent pipe end weld removal.

Author Keywords: the sum of squares of residuals

articleTitle: Research on Actively Supported Accurate Sensing Control Technology for Primary Frequency Regulation of Wind Farms
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper designs an active support type wind farm primary frequency control system with precise sensing. The system has a new primary frequency regulation control device which is associated with the AGC system of station, and they are functionally interactive and coordinated. When frequency regulation is needed, the device calculates integrated target value based on AGC target command and real-time calculated frequency components. The system sends the regulation command to energy management platform through a special high-speed communication management device, and the primary frequency regulation function of wind farm is realized at the grid connection point. This technology enables wind farms to meet the requirements of relevant standards and regulations. It can reduce grid assessment and improve economic efficiency of wind farms. It can promote wind farms to change from passive adaptation to active support of grid frequency and the healthy development of wind power industry.

articleTitle: Parametric Design and Performance Analysis of Drive Axle Housings Based on Secondary Development of UG NX
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: As a transmission and support component in a vehicle, the drive axle housing necessitates repeated simulation and analysis to optimize the design. The modeling process is time-consuming and has an impact on the effectiveness of the design. The drive axle housing parametric modeling is the focus of this paper. With the aid of UG NX secondary development of UG NX/Open related tools, the application framework, application function, and drive axle housing model have all been successfully developed. The feasibility of the model derived from the parametric modeling as a theoretical analysis model was confirmed, and the effectiveness of the drive axle housing design was enhanced.

articleTitle: Research on Characteristic Diagnostic Control Method of Multivariate Quality Based on Fruit Fly Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low efficiency of quality diagnosis based on multivariate quality data in the process of product manufacturing quality control and diagnosis, a diagnosis method based on improved principal component analysis (PCA) based on autoregressive moving average and fruit fly optimization algorithm was proposed. The linear mapping of traditional principal component analysis can not effectively deal with the correlation between different batches of multivariate quality characteristics data, and can improve the speed and accuracy of diagnosis. The T<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> control chart was used to monitor the multivariate quality characteristic data, and the out-of-control sample data were processed by the autoregressive moving principal component analysis algorithm, and then the fruit fly optimization algorithm was used to diagnose the out-of-control factors. Finally, an example is given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Computer Simulation of Axle Hub Structure Optimization of a Heavy Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In recent years, the lightweight design requirements for heavy vehicles are increasingly high. Under the premise of meeting the safety performance requirements, the lightweight products with stable quality will be more influential in the competition. The wheel hub is a very important part of the axle of heavy truck. The traditional structure design uses more materials, resulting in the structure mass is larger, very bulky. Axle hub of a heavy vehicle original structure 33kg, the structure is relatively heavy. We optimized its structure and reduced its weight by 9kg after optimization. In this paper, the finite element software ansys is used to analyze the optimized structure of a heavy vehicle hub, and the yield limit of the optimized structure is greatly improved. The research on lightweight design of wheel hub is provided as reference.

articleTitle: Research progress and trend analysis of virtual manufacturing based on CiteSpace
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Virtual manufacturing technology is an advanced manufacturing technology that uses computer modeling and simulation technology to build a digital model of a production system and then simulate the real manufacturing process. This paper analyzes the research progress and trend of virtual manufacturing based on CiteSpace. Firstly, taking Scopus as the paper retrieval platform, collected 6091 papers related to the virtual manufacturing field. Secondly, based on CiteSpace, carried out co-occurrence and clustering, and drew a map of National (regional) scientific research cooperation relationships, a map of hotspots in the virtual manufacturing field, and a keyword emergence diagram. The international cooperation, research hotspots, and research frontiers in the virtual manufacturing field are summarized successively. It is pointed out that Industry 4.0 theory and intelligent technology represented by Digital Twin are the future research focus.

articleTitle: Research on the frame of formation of multi-USV
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The research of formation is a multi-objective constrained problem. Path planning and collision avoidance is an important task in the formation and application of unmanned surface vessel (USV). It is necessary to generate the path from the specified starting point to the end point, meet the constraint of space collision avoidance on the multi-objective crossing path, and pursue the shortest formation time of the whole formation as far as possible. In this paper, a framework of multi-agent target path planning algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the A-star algorithm is selected to generate waypoints, and then then introduces the safe distance to constrain the movement time and state of different agents. From the level of overall target path planning, the strategy of delayed start is adopted to set the action state of different agents. Simulation results show that the algorithm is effective. The experimental results show that the algorithm avoids the path conflict between unmanned vehicles and effectively ensures the path safety.

articleTitle: Step Motor Control Based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Stepping motor has the advantages of simple control, accurate positioning, no accumulated error and low rotor inertia. Stepping motor has a very bright performance in the field of automation, which has obvious propulsion effect on the formation of mechatronics system. After using the stepping motor, the error of the motor is reduced, and the positioning of the motor is more accurate. At the same time, combining the stepping motor with PLC can significantly enhance the advantages of the stepping motor. In this paper, the stepping motor based on PLC control is the main research topic. On the hardware design of the system, the design is made from the following aspects: the selection of PLC model, I/O points of input and output, the principle of automatic control and control circuit. In the software design of the system, the control program of the system is analyzed to ensure that the design requirements are met, and it has certain practical application value.

articleTitle: Real-time mechanical performance analysis of pusher structure of packaging machine based on digital twin system
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Digital Twin realizes the virtual reality interaction between the physical world and the information world, and can comprehensively and accurately evaluate the operation status of physical devices in the virtual space. Aiming at the problem of real-time mechanical performance evaluation of packaging machine pusher structure, this paper studies the real-time mechanical performance analysis based on digital twin technology, and focuses on the implementation methods of typical working condition finite element analysis, finite element proxy model and visualization model of stress nephogram. Based on the finite element proxy model and visualization model of stress nephogram, the stress distribution of key components under different working conditions is visualized, which lays a foundation for the optimization design of equipment structure and life prediction.

articleTitle: Optimizing of vertical lathe sliding pillow based on TRIZ/DOE
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aim to reduce the deformation of sliding pillow in vertical lathe, related literature are reviewed and find that parameter optimization design method is widely used. However, this method is in essence to compromise the design parameters and does not eliminate the design conflicts. Therefore, the combination of TRIZ and parameter optimization design method is proposed to solve this problem. Our job include next three steps. Firstly, the framework of parameter optimization design combined with TRIZ is proposed. Secondly, the flowchart of combining TRIZ with parameter optimization design is established. Finally, the proposed method was applied to redesign the sliding pillow. ANSYS Workbench software was used to optimize the design, and lightweight and reducing deformation were taken as the design objectives. The simulation results show that, compared with the original design, the sliding pillow deformation is reduced by 17.049%, and the proposed method extends the conceptual solution space of the simple parameter optimization design method.

articleTitle: Research on Lubrication and Lubricating Oil Supply Strategy of Low-speed Diesel Engine Cylinder-Piston Ring Pack
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In view of the characteristics of Marine low speed diesel engine cylinder lubrication using external oil injection, a lubrication model for cross-head two-stroke diesel engine cylinder liner and piston ring pack was established. The orthogonal experimental design method is used to comprehensively analyze the influence of three factors, “oil injection timing”, “oil feed rate” and “oil injection hole position”, on the frictional work loss of the piston ring pack. Combined with genetic optimization algorithm and BP neural network, the optimization goal is to minimize the friction loss of piston ring pack, and further quantitative analysis of the orthogonal test results is carried out. The optimized design shows that: when the thickness of the oil film at the inlet of the cylinder liner surface is 3µm, the optimal combination is “oil injection timing (advance) + 8ms, oil feed rate 0.9g/kW. h, oil injection hole position angle 140°CA”. When the thickness of the oil film at the surface inlet is 2µm, the optimal combination is “oil injection timing (advance) + 12ms, oil feed rate 1.0g/kW. h, oil injection hole position angle 100°CA”.

articleTitle: The Acoustic Pressure Enhancement of Piezoelectric Micro-Machined Ultrasonic Transducer
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Miniaturization and integration are the biggest advantages of film Piezoelectric Micro-machined Ultrasonic Transducer (PMUT). However the small size also limits the application of film transducer in high power field. In order to replace traditional bulk material transducer with PMUT in some special applications, the vibration sensitivity and acoustic pressure of the transducer need to be improved. This paper proposes a novel PMUT structure with concentric circle and ring electrodes. We use 2nm PZT (lead zirconate titanate) film to fabricate PMUT array. Based on the piezoelectric theory and processing methods of Micro Electro-Mechanical System (MEMS), some simulations and experimental validations are carried out to verify the proposed transducer structure. With differential voltage input, the vibration sensitivity is better than 13nm/V in the air. After device packaging, the sound pressure generated by the PMUT is up to 580kPa at the position 2mm away from the vibrating surface underwater.

articleTitle: Structural Topology Optimization of an Aero Vehicle's Magnesium Alloy Bottom Cover
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Magnesium Alloy with lower density, has higher specific strength and stiffness, and therefore it is one of the most important development directions of light weight design for aero vehicle. A light weight design of an aero vehicle's magnesium alloy bottom cover was taken for example in this paper. According to the requirement of manufacturing process, the structural topology optimization of the was magnesium alloy bottom cover established. The theory of continuum topology optimization was applied to obtain the best material distribution. Considering the character of the magnesium alloy fracture failure, the galvanic corrosion of the magnesium alloy and the manufacturability of the bottom cover, the result of topology optimization was improved. The result of FEM analysis showed that the final design met all the requirements. A static load experiment of the bottom cover was carried out, and the result showed the same conclusion.

articleTitle: Aerodynamic drag estimation of ultra-low orbit spacecraft
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The ultra-low orbit spacecraft has the advantages of high resolution, easy de-orbit and low launch cost. Although that atmospheric density at this height is only 10–11 to 10-9kg/m3, the aerodynamic drag acting on the satellite can be millinewton or even Newton, which is the main reason for the fall of the ultra-low orbit spacecraft. In this paper, the method of aerodynamic drag estimation for the ultra-low orbit spacecraft is given, and the influence factors of aerodynamic drag are analysed, the calculation formula of drag coefficient is emphatically derived, and the influence factors of drag coefficient are studied. The drag coefficients under the conditions of typical orbit and space environment are given. In order to reduce the drag, the SLO spacecraft should be designed as a slender body configuration, and at this time, the drag effect brought by the side cannot be ignored, which should be paid more attention to in the overall configuration and layout design of the spacecraft.

articleTitle: Study on the performance of shell and tube heat exchanger under different shell flow patterns
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to study the performance differences of the shell side fluid of shell and tube heat exchanger in three flow regimes: transverse flow, longitudinal flow and helical flow, three heat exchangers with different baffle structures, namely, bow baffle, baffle rod and flower baffle, were constructed, and their numerical simulation analysis was carried out with FLUENT software to compare their heat transfer performance, resistance performance and comprehensive performance under different Reynolds numbers. The results show that the For the baffle rod heat exchanger, when the Reynolds number is less than 1676, the heat transfer influence factor is greater than the flower plate. When the Reynolds number is less than 2515, the heat transfer influence factor is greater than the bow baffle plate. With the Reynolds number continues to increase, the heat transfer influence factor gradually decreases. For the flower baffle, the influence factor of heat transfer is about 1.1, which is always greater than the arch baffle. When the Reynolds number is 25152, the resistance influence factor of the flower baffle is 6% smaller than that of the bow baffle, and the resistance influence factor of the baffle is 16% smaller than that of the bow baffle.

articleTitle: Match analysis of green manufacturing based on cloud platform
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: As the scale of the manufacturing industry continues to expand and environmental problems are gradually exposed, green manufacturing is an inevitable choice for the current manufacturing industry. This paper considers a secondary supply chain composed of manufacturers and suppliers, with the purpose of encouraging both parties to adopt green and low-carbon behaviors, for the two cases of cloud platform or not, a game model is established, establishes a game model, conducts matching analysis, and obtains the optimal pricing strategy for government subsidies and platform certification fees. Meanwhile, the environmental impact (EI) is introduced to evaluate the matching results of the matching

articleTitle: Key Technology of Multi-arc Parallel Additive Manufacturing Equipment Control System: Research on realizing multi-arc cooperative communication and HCI
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Metal arc additive manufacturing technology has the advantages of high deposition efficiency and low manufacturing cost. In this paper, the key technologies of multi-arc parallel additive manufacturing equipment control system based on tungsten inert gas welding are studied. Firstly, the multi-arc parallel additive manufacturing equipment control system architecture is designed to realize the control of different types of objects. A low-coupling hierarchical multi-process software structure based on Redis memory database is proposed to customize the multi-arc parallel control system. The multi-arc parallel additive manufacturing equipment control system was developed, and the human-computer interaction interface of additive manufacturing process was designed based on QT graphical framework. The parallel control of multi-arc and information feedback in additive manufacturing process were realized, and the production quality was improved.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Temperature Prediction Method Based on PSO-ELM
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The tuyere raceway is a very complex area in the process of blast furnace (BF) smelting and an important reaction area for stable operation of BF. Stable and accurate detection of combustion states in this area extremely important for the quality of molten iron, maintaining an active hearth, running the furnace smoothly, and extending the life of the furnace, it determines the heat demand of the BF and tons of iron fuel consumption. Therefore, the PSO-ELM method is proposed to study the change of tuyere raceway temperature. In this method, PSO is used to select the optimal parameters of the ELM model and ELM is used to predict the temperature quickly. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is validated by using BF data. The experimental results show that this method can accurately predict the tuyere raceway temperature.

articleTitle: The quality inspection of railway vehicle gearbox based on Q-switched wavelet sparse decomposition
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The quality inspection of gearbox has always been a difficult problem in the industry. A quality inspection method is proposed based on Q-switched wavelet sparse decomposition for the railway vehicle gearbox. It uses Q-switched wavelet transform to construct a sparse dictionary, establishes a sparse decomposition objective function, and uses the Lagrange contraction algorithm to solve the objective function, so as to decompose the monitoring signal into harmonic signal and shock signal, and finally extracts the pulse factor and skewness from the harmonic signal. The gear box fault is identified by using the pulse factor and skewness, and the fault is located by using the envelope spectrum of harmonic signal and shock signal. The bench test verifies the effectiveness of the quality inspection method for railway vehicle gearbox based on Q-switched wavelet sparse decomposition.

articleTitle: The Frame Response Time Interval Based Device Fingerprinting Identification
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Channel state information (CSI)-based wireless device fingerprinting provides an effective authentication scheme at the physical layer of wireless communication devices using CSI short-time invariance, but appears to be inadequate for long-time communication authentication or scenarios that require intermittent authentication. To address this problem, we propose to construct a wireless device fingerprint using frame response time interval (FRTI) and combine a CSI-based wireless dynamic device fingerprint to form a multi-domain fusion wireless device identification and authentication method, which can effectively identify and authenticate wireless devices at the time of wireless device access and during continuous wireless device communication to ensure safe and reliable operation of wireless devices. The experimental results under different scenarios show that using the multi-domain fusion method of frame response interval and channel state information for wireless device identification can significantly improve the accuracy of calculation and transmission delay, and the identification rate reaches more than 95%.

articleTitle: Research on the economic-statistical model of VSI control chart based on multiple mass variation factors
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Statistical control chart is an important tool for statistical process control, which is used to keep the production process under control to ensure product manufacturing quality. The traditional control chart is static, while the recently developed control chart is dynamic. This dynamic design enables the control chart to detect abnormal fluctuations in the process more quickly. The criteria for measuring the quality of control charts are mainly statistical characteristics and implementation costs, that is, statistical and economic. There are many researches on statistical characteristics in China, but few on economic characteristics. In this paper, we first study the design method of variable sampling interval <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\text{VSI}\overline{X})$</tex> control chart, and construct the model of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{VSI}\overline{X}$</tex> control chart using Markov chain method. On the basis of sorting out the statistical performance indicators to measure the quality of dynamic <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\overline{X}$</tex> control chart, the statistical performance expression is derived. Secondly, the economic model of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{VSI}\overline{X}\text{control}$</tex> chart is established, and the parameters of the proposed economic model are optimized based on genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: A New Image-Based Temperature Prediction Method
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The hearth temperature is an important index to measure the condition of blast furnace (BF). A good and reasonable hearth temperature can maintain the stable production of BF, which is a direct guarantee to realize the longevity and efficiency of BF. Therefore, an image-based multiple rank matrix regression (MRMR) temperature prediction method is proposed to study the change of tuyere raceway temperature. This method takes matrix as the input of the model and considers the spatial position information of the matrix elements. According to the intrinsic property of the projection vectors, the relevant constraints are applied to avoid the overfitting problem. Finally, the prediction performance of the model is validated by using BF data.

articleTitle: Studies on Calibration of Shaking Incubator
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The shaking incubator is an incubator which consists of shaker and heating chamber for incubating and shaking sensitive samples. It replaces two devices, reducing both time and space needed. Both the shaking mechanism and temperature chamber are regulated via microprocessors, which control all sensors for motor speed, temperature and time. It is suitable for biochemistry, microbiology and clinical laboratories in which applications require temperature and shaking treatment. This article presents a novel design of calibration method of shaking incubator by studying the essential metrological parameters of the device. The experimental results show that the calibration method presented in this article can establish the metrological traceability system of shaking incubator in China in order to ensure the accuracy and reliability of the device, which is of great importance for the quality control of the device.

articleTitle: Deep Fault Diagnosis of Marine Diesel Generator Sets Based on Multi-Level Decision Fusion Model
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The effective fault diagnosis of the diesel generator sets can enable maintenance personnel to locate the fault location timely and accurately, and find the cause of the fault, which plays a vital role in ensuring the stable and reliable operation of the diesel generator sets. In order to fuse multiple evidence bodies and solve the problems such as uncertainty in fault diagnosis caused by single information, this paper combines the Deep Belief Network with D-S evidence theory to build a multi-level decision fusion model to realize the deep diagnosis of diesel generator sets fault, which can not only locate the fault location but also get the fault cause. The calculation results show that the model is effective in improving the accuracy of fault diagnosis for diesel generator sets, and improves the reliability of fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Arc-Fault Detection using One-Dimension Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Being one of the major safety concerns, arc-faults need to be properly detected and addressed. Arcs are commonly existed in both faulty circuits and devices under normal operation, which makes accurate arc-fault detection challenging as manually modeling arc-faults is difficult. This paper proposed to use one-dimension convolution neural network to detect arc-faults. Neural network has demonstrate its capability in other classification problems which are difficult for tradition modeling approach such as image or text recognition. By nature, arc-fault detection using current waveform is a classification task on time- series, which is suitable for one-dimension convolution network. In addition, this paper also investigate in using partial cycle data after zero crossings, instead of full cycle data as used in existing methods, to detect arc-fault, which can further reduce model complexity and allow more precise measurement. The proposed method can achieve 98.996% accuracy while using only one eighth of each cycle of current and 99.543% accuracy with a quarter cycle of current. Finally, this work also briefly studied and estimated the performance of the proposed model if to be deployed on embedded hardware for real time usage.

articleTitle: Modeling and Testing Analysis of Prepositioning Accuracy of CNC Turret
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: CNC turret is the key functional part of numerical control lathe. Whether the prepositioning accuracy reaches the standard is directly related to whether the positioning accuracy link of the CNC turret can proceed smoothly, and then affects the machining accuracy of the numerical control lathe. In this paper, according to the structure of CNC turret, the main parts that affect the prepositioning accuracy are the gear and its supporting shaft, and then the mapping relationship between the manufacturing and assembly accuracy of the above parts and the prepositioning accuracy of the end is constructed. On this basis, I systematically studied the effects such as module of gear, tooth number, shaft runout clearance and other factors on prepositioning accuracy. The end accuracy probability distribution of gear pairs with different accuracy levels was obtained based on Monte Carlo method, and the probability of the prepositioning accuracy of the CNC turret within 8 arc min was obtained through 100,000 data simulation and statistics. Finally, a checking instrument of prepositioning accuracy of CNC turret is built, and the actual prepositioning accuracy of CNC turret is obtained based on the test.

articleTitle: Research Progress of Electrical Discharge and Electrochemical Hybrid Machining Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: High quality machining of difficult-to-cut materials has always been a hot topic in the realm of advanced manufacturing. Electrical discharge and electrochemical hybrid machining (EDM-ECM) combines the strong points of EDM and ECM, which can achieve high-precision and high surface quality machining, and it plays an increasingly momentous role in the machining of difficult-to-cut materials. However, there is no systematic review of the current state of EDM-ECM technology. Working fluid is the linchpin for the appropriate combination of EDM and ECM in EDM-ECM. Meanwhile, the material removal mechanisms of EDM and ECM coexist in EDM-EDM, and the adjustment of the machining mechanism is the crux to give full play to its machining effect. In this paper, the research status of EDM-ECM working fluids is first reviewed. Secondly, the conversion of mechanisms in EDM-EDM machining is summarized. Then, the areas of application of EDM-ECM technology are introduced. Finally, the possible future efforts to expand the scope of the application of the technology are discussed and the ideas for future research work are provided.

articleTitle: Beidou+PS-InSAR Technology for Substation Geological Subsidence Monitoring and Early Warning Research
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The normal operation of substation equipment requires higher ground settlement and differential settlement. This paper combines BeiDou high-precision positioning technology with InSAR technology, and proposes BeiDou+PS-InSAR technology to realize the monitoring of substation geological subsidence. This paper first uses BeiDou high-precision positioning technology to obtain the characteristic information of substation geological deformation displacement, and then analyzes the trend and law of substation geological deformation. Secondly, the phase of PS target is modeled and solved by using PS-INSAR technology, the nonlinear deformation, atmospheric delay and the phase of orbit error is separated by space-time filtering method. Finally, the deformation time series at each PS point can be obtained by superposing linear and nonlinear deformation. The BeiDou+PS-InSAR technology proposed in this paper can continuously monitor the high risk points of geological subsidence in substations in real time and give early warning when geological anomalies occur in substations.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis and Experimental Research on Differential Pressure Flow between Venturi and Orifice
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this paper, a theoretical research and application comparison of two differential pressure flowmeters measurement principles which are orifice plate and venturi was conducted to verify that the venturi flowmeters is suitable for high precision flow measurement in small flow rate dust particle counter and planktonic bacteria flow calibration device. The theoretical research was carried out by changing the throttle structure parameters, media type and temperature parameters in the software fluent, and experimental research between the venturi and orifice were carried out in the same conditions. Theoretical simulation results show that the venturi internal pressure distribution is relatively balanced, in the same flow state, the internal pressure of the orifice plate is much larger than the venturi. At the same time, the experimental results show that the venturi flowmeters measurement error is about ± 0.75<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, the orifice plate flowmeters measurement error is about ± 1.50%, and the venturi flowmeters measurement accuracy is better than the orifice plate flowmeters. Therefore, the venturi flowmeters is suitable for use as a flowmeters in a small flow rate dust particle counter and planktonic bacteria flow calibration device.

articleTitle: Order Priority Decision of Manufacturing Enterprises: An Improved Delphi-AHP-TOPSIS Methodology
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low production efficiency and high manufacturing cost caused by the disorder of order sorting in manufacturing enterprises. This paper presents an improved Delphi-AHP-TOPSIS method. Firstly, Delphi method is used to determine the main evaluation criteria and sub-criterion by experts. Secondly, the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is used to compare each index. After that, the relative weight of the criteria is determined through the subjective judgment of many expert. Thirdly, the decision-making scheme is scored and ranked based on the technique for order preference by similarity to ideal solution (TOPSIS). Finally, the improved method is compared with the single AHP or TOPSIS method by introducing the adjacent scheme differentiation method. The simulation results have shown that the improved Delphi-AHP-TOPSIS method proposed in this paper can effectively guide manufacturing enterprises to make order priority decisions.

articleTitle: The Research of Droppable Ballast Device of Manned Submersible based on Computer-aided Ergonomics design
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aimed at the practical application problems of droppable ballast device, Through the design method of ergonomics and closely combining with the practical application, Carrying out the optimization and research of droppable ballast device base on the “JIAOLONG” Manned Submersible. On the basis of analyzing the application of typical characteristics of droppable ballast device in China and overseas, especially for the working condition and structural characteristics of “JIAOLONG” Manned Submersible, We carried out the design improvements, And the introduction of CAD / CAM / CAE technology in the design of computer-aided design, Finally, the key components are analyzed and studied. It has important practical significance through optimization of key technologies and equipment designed to operate on the body of the “JIAOLONG” manned submersibles to carry out

articleTitle: Fluid Simulation of Trajectory Stabilization System for High Speed Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: As an advanced aerospace technology, the high speed aircraft has a broad technical prospect. Due to the changeable flight environment, the aerodynamic characteristics and the thermal characteristics change dramatically. Therefore, the flight process is prone to instability out of control. In this paper, a flight trajectory stabilization system is studied to address this problem. Based on this stabilization system, steady and transient fluid simulations were performed. The aerodynamic characteristics of the aircraft and the stabilizer were carefully studied at the Mach 6 flight speed of different altitudes in the atmosphere. The aerodynamic force and the stress of the structure were calculated. Finally, the operating performance was evaluated according to simulation data and the structure was optimized. The results show that the system can effectively make the aircraft spin in the terminal flight and the flight can enter a steady state. The aerodynamic load and structural stress are reduced by optimizing the aerodynamic profile of wrap-around fins. The working performance and structural reliability are improved significantly. This has important implications for ensuring the stable flight of vehicles in the terminal phase.

articleTitle: Research on key technologies of random stacking components automatically crawl
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Given the growing demand for intelligence in industrial production, the key technology of robotic arm automatically crawling is being studied and realized using random stacking components as the research object. To begin, the global feature descriptor PPF algorithm is used to extract part features. The visible points that meet the conditions are then combined pairwise in the off-line training stage, and the characteristics of point pairs are calculated to obtain the model describing the object's global information. The components are identified during the online matching stage by employing a voting strategy based on the Hough transform. The RANSAC algorithm is then used for rough pose estimation, and the ICP algorithm is used to fine-tune the pose result to obtain the target's optimal pose estimation. Finally, the transformation matrix after hand-eye calibration based on differential evolution algorithm determines the position and posture of the parts in the real world coordinate system, guiding the manipulator to accurately grab and place the stacked parts. A grab system was built to test it as part of a water pump production line reconstruction project. Using the pump body as an example, the results show that the number of features of the selected point pair is 730,830, the matching accuracy can reach 94.64<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, and the matching time consumption is 1.1424 s; the overall average grabbing success rate is 92.3%, which is practical.

articleTitle: Mothed and System of Visibility Analysis Based on Human Eye Imaging Process
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The human eye is the most important organ to perceive the external environment, and visibility analysis is the basis of ergonomic design and evaluation. The current mainstream visual simulation tools mainly focus on the qualitative analysis within the visual range, lacking the optical modeling process in the complex human-machine-environment system, and cannot reflect the visual features of the human eyes under different working conditions. According to the principle of the rendering pipeline of the current manifold graphics simulation engine, a human vision simulation method based on physical rendering theory is proposed. A real-time rendering engine is designed and implemented. Experiments are carried out on the components of the visual system (camera, lighting and materials), and the results are evaluated using a unified glare evaluation model. The experiments show that the proposed method is helpful to determine the appropriate position and posture of virtual human. Aiming at CATIA platform, CAA/C++technology is adopted to realize the visual analysis component, which further broadens the visibility analysis of CATIA.

articleTitle: Degradation Prediction of Li-ion Batteries based on Linear Mixed Effects Model with Mixtrure Prior
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Degradation modelling and prediction of a li-ion battery (LIB) is essential for its health management, which can guide timely maintenance to avoid catastrophic consequences. There are many methods have been developed to achieve this end, among which data-driven methods have received extensive attention and realized promising results. However, exiting methods do not take the clustering behavior of different degradation paths into consideration, while ignoring the difference among various clusters can lead to deteriorated prediction performance. To address this research gap, a linear mixed effects model (LME) with mixture prior, i.e., MP-LME, is proposed in this study. Specifically, a multinomial distribution is introduced to describe the probability that a battery belonging to each cluster; then, within each cluster, an LME model is proposed to simulate the degradation path of LIBs in this cluster; lastly, model parameters are updated with the observed data of a new battery to predict its future degradation path. This model can generate accurate degradation prediction for a LIB by leveraging valuable information of LIBs in clusters with similar degradation behavior and avoiding negative effect due to dissimilar fading characteristics. The performance and superiority of the proposed method are validated with a degradation dataset of LIBs under randomized loading profiles.

articleTitle: Construction and application of digital twin model for tool wear monitoring and life prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problems existing in accurate monitoring of tool wear status and accurate prediction of tool life, there is no reliable basis for decision-making on tool selection, replacement and grinding, which seriously affects the optimization and control of precise tool utilization and the dynamic regulation of production systems. Aiming at this problem, based on the concept of digital twin, a digital twin model for tool wear monitoring and life prediction is proposed. The model consists of three parts: digital model, analysis data model and evaluation model. Complete the collection and fusion of heterogeneous data and the evaluation and prediction for different targets. According to the different wear stages of the tool, three monitoring and prediction modes are proposed. Make full use of the value of multi-dimensional data information. Monitoring and forecasting services are provided for different demand levels, taking the cost, efficiency and accuracy of forecasting. into account, Supports the precise use of tools.

articleTitle: Influence mechanism of Valve opening on flow field stability of bypass valve of conventional island Steam Turbine
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The bypass valve of the steam turbine is one of the most critical valves in a conventional island. Its flow field stability is directly related to the nuclear power plant's long-term safe and stable operation. In this paper, the high-pressure labyrinth bypass valve, which is widely used in the conventional island of a nuclear power plant, is taken as the object of study. Based on the compressibility of the working mass, the accuracy of the numerical model is verified by first comparing it with the experimental value, and then the correlation between the valve opening and the stability of the flow field in the valve is studied. The results show that with the increase of valve opening, the resistance characteristics of the valve show a “three-segment” distribution, and the friction coefficient reaches the maximum value at 30% opening; the labyrinth component plays a majorly throttling role when the valve opening degree is less than 60%, the stability of the pressure field and velocity field in this opening range gradually increases with the increase of valve opening, and the changes are comparatively sensitive; however, when the valve opening degree is more than 60%, the local flow in the valve core is transformed into the supersonic flow, and the irreversible loss at the cage network structure is comparatively large. With the increase of the valve opening, the stability of the pressure field is lower. And the velocity field is slightly enhanced, but the sensitivity to the change of the valve opening is comparatively low. The results play a guiding role in regulating the bypass valve set of the steam turbine and bear great significance to the safe operation of the unit and tapping the exploitation of energy-saving potential.

articleTitle: Markov blanket-embedded PSO algorithm for Bayesian network structure learning
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the Bayesian network (BN) structure search process, due to the uncertainty of the initial population, the learning efficiency in the structural optimization process is reduced, and the convergence speed is slowed down. We propose a Markov blanket-embedded particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm for BN structure learning in our research. In particular, the efficient and effective discovery of the Markov blanket method is used to obtain the undirected network framework. A local topology is established for each node to implement the initialization. Parameter adaptive adjustment is carried out through an improved PSO algorithm. Initial population distribution information is adjusted through Algorithm parameters. For improved structure, a search efficiency mutation mechanism is added for increased diversity. The experimental results show that our algorithm can get better search accuracy and faster convergence speed than other algorithms.

articleTitle: A Structural Optimization Method for Constant and Variable Stiffness Composite Laminates
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Equivalent single-layer theory is widely used in the analysis of fiber-reinforced composite laminate structures, but this theory cannot accurately evaluate the stress and deformation of thick plates. In order to improve the accuracy of the structural optimization design of composite laminate, we propose a topology optimization method of composite laminate based on the layerwise theory. Firstly, the displacement field model of laminates is given by using layerwise theory. Then, with the goal of maximizing stiffness and flexibility, topology optimization equations for composite laminates are established. The structural optimization problem of straight/curved fiber-reinforced composite laminates under different conditions is studied. Finally, several simulation cases are designed to evaluate the accuracy of the layerwise theory and the performance of the proposed topology optimization method. The results show that the calculation accuracy is much higher when using the layerwise theory for structural deformation analysis and optimization than that of the classical laminate theory.

articleTitle: Application of Grey Markov Prediction Model in Airline EDP Maintenance Requirement Decision
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Engine Driven Pump (EDP) is a kind of high-priced turnaround part that is the key concern in airline material management, and its disassembly, maintenance, and storage have a great impact on airline material procurement costs. It is an important requirement for airlines to explore an efficient and accurate method to determine the maintenance requirements of high-priced working parts. In this paper, a gray Markov model-based EDP maintenance demand prediction method is proposed, and the prediction model is validated with the list of EDP failures of an airline's Airbus A320 fleet from 2015–2019 as the data source. Firstly, the discrete and random characteristics of the EDP class of high-priced turnover parts avionics failures were analyzed; secondly, the EDP maintenance demand quantity was calculated by the traditional model based on the relevant data such as fleet size, flight time, unscheduled teardown interval time, etc; again, by establishing a gray GM(1,1) prediction model, dividing four states, constructing a state transfer matrix, and making subsequent state prediction, and calculate the EDP maintenance demand prediction result for 2018 based on the data from 2015-2017; finally, compare the real value of 2018, the prediction result of GM(1,1), and the MAPR and RMSE of the prediction result of the gray Markov model, to determine the effect of the demand decision model. The study shows that the gray Markov model prediction has high accuracy in EDP failure prediction, has a high fit for the original data, effectively reduces the prediction error, improves the accuracy of the prediction results, and is suitable for the prediction of EDP maintenance demand quantity. And the prediction results of the model are only related to the current state, which can effectively reduce the dependence of the prediction on historical data, especially for the abruptly changed data in 2019, the prediction method reduces the influence of such data. In airline material procurement and storage management, the gray Markov prediction model can provide strong support for EDP maintenance demand decisions.

Author Keywords: high-priced turnover parts maintenance requirements decision

articleTitle: QMIX Multiple Intelligences Reinforcement Learning Damping Control for Cylindrical Shell
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: One of the fundamental mechanical constructions of ships and navigators is the cylindrical shell structure.
