Their damping control is difficult to predict and frequently depends on precise control models. For that reason, this work provides a data-driven multi-intelligence reinforcement learning damping control approach that is significance for damping control of massive structures. Firstly, the dynamics equations of cylindrical shell structure are established based on the hypothetical modal method, and modal variables are introduced to derive the state-space equations for damping control of cylindrical shell structure, and an interactive environment for multi-intelligent reinforcement learning is established. Secondly, the damping control strategy of cylindrical shell structure with multiple intelligences is designed based on the value decomposition QMIX algorithm. For a single smart body design vibration displacement, velocity, piezoelectric actuator voltage, smart body operation steps as the state space, quadratic performance indicators with saturation characteristics as the damping effect reward function, greedy strategy as damping action selection method for multi-intelligent body cooperative damping. The QMIX algorithm hybrid network performs fusion evaluation of the joint action value of each intelligence and updates the action value function of a single intelligence. Finally, five sets of hyperparameters are set based on the Grid Search approach for comparative simulation experiments for deep learning network hyperparameter selection. The result of the simulation demonstrate that the current tactic effectively suppresses the vibration of the cylindrical shell construction. Furthermore, the optimal hyperparameter is determined by comparing simulation trials with different values, proving that the approach described in this article has better damping performance under this parameter.

articleTitle: Study of Flow Field Characteristics Under Simultaneous Regulation of Dual Valve Sets for Conventional Island Condensate
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Condensate regulating valve is a key equipment to maintain the water level of deaerator and regulate the pressure of mother tube, which plays an important role in nuclear power operation. A nuclear power condensate double valve group as the research object, through the three-dimensional flow field of non-constant simulation, the double valve synchronous adjustment under the opening on the internal flow field changes, energy dissipation process and noise characteristics of the condensate valve group, and the flow field simulation results as the applied load, the use of finite element simulation method for structural strength analysis and modal vibration study of the valve body. The results show that: the multi-stage sleeve orifice structure is the main throttling and pressure reducing element in the valve, and there is a large velocity and pressure gradient inside; as the valve opening increases, the maximum velocity, turbulence and noise position inside the valve are gradually clustered upward from the bottom of the sleeve, and the value gradually decreases; the excitation load along the main flow direction inside the valve causes the largest local deformation of the sleeve, and the long-term operation may be the main cause of sleeve fatigue fracture cause.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Electromagnetic Output Force of Linear Motor with Single Magnetic Steel or Dual Magnetic Steel
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Taking the dual magnetic steel force motor used in a certain type of direct drive valve as the research object, the corresponding single magnetic steel force motor is derived according to its structure. Due to the similar structure of the single magnetic steel force motor and the dual magnetic steel force motor, the Ansoft electromagnetic simulation software can be used under the same conditions of armature parameters, air gap width, number of coil turns, and parts materials, etc. By analyzing the difference between the output force of single magnetic and dual magnetic force motors, the characteristics of the electromagnetic output force of both are determined.

articleTitle: On machine detection of tool breakage based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of tool breakage in flat end milling, this paper proposes a machine vision based detection method to detect the tool on machine. Taking the flat end mill as the research object, the machine vision measuring device is used to take the image sequence of tool rotation, scan and calculate the maximum value of tool breakage on the image, and compare this value with the determination threshold to determine whether the tool breakage occurs. The on machine experiment shows that the method can effectively detect whether the tool is broken, the detection speed is fast, the accuracy is high and the performance of the measurement system is stable.

articleTitle: Simultaneous localization and mapping for tethered robot based on UFastSLAM
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The tethered mobile robot can be used to detect extreme terrain. During the movement, it will inevitably contact or even entangle with obstacles. In this paper, a simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) algorithm for tethered robots based on the UFastSLAM framework is proposed, which uses particle filtering and unscented transformation to estimate the pose of the tethered robot and the positions of the anchor points. The simulation results show that the algorithm can effectively estimate the position of anchor points and improve the performance of robot pose estimation simultaneously.

articleTitle: Intelligent Itinerant Inspection Technology of Aircraft Based on Deep Learning and AR
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Itinerant inspection of aircraft is an important link to ensure the smooth flight of aircraft at high altitude. At present, the inspection of civil aviation aircraft mainly depends on human visual inspection, which is greatly affected by the environment, time-consuming and labor-intensive, and has many defects. To solve these problems, this paper proposes an intelligent itinerant inspection method based on deep learning and AR. Collect relevant pictures of aircraft defects and expand them to form a data set. Use the yolov5 network to train and learn the characteristics of various types of aircraft defects, form a specific depth learning model, and integrate it into AR glasses to identify aircraft defects. Use augmented reality to display the identification results. Finally, the Boeing 878 aircraft was taken as the object for experimental verification, and the aircraft defect recognition rate reached 80%, which verified the effectiveness of this aircraft intelligent itinerant technology.

articleTitle: Bearing Fault Detection Method Based on GA-Xgboost Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Bearing fault detection plays a vital role in the industry. However, current detection systems cannot identify bearing faults robustly and easily. Therefore, this paper proposes a novel algorithm to achieve fault detection of bearing based on GA-xgboost learning. SMOTE algorithm is used to deal with unbalanced data sets. Xgboost is utilized to predict bearing faults according to bearing features. Furthermore, a genetic algorithm (GA) is applied to make optimal hyperparameters of the machine learning model. The experiment results demonstrate that the algorithm can predict and detect the fault of bearing effectively with an accuracy of 96%.

articleTitle: Research on workshop manufacturing resource location method based on industrial Internet of things
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The industrial internet of things has become the main solution of the dynamic scheduling method used in the workshop scheduling mechanism. Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) technology is an effective method to locate manufacturing resources in the workshop. RFID technology is mainly used for automatic identification and providing accurate location information. In RFID application, it mainly meets two different monitoring requirements: target detection and target accurate positioning. When locating workshop resources based on RFID system, it is necessary to set the location and number of RFID readers. Due to the unreliability of RFID itself, the reader will miss the tags within its detection range. In this paper, an RFID network planning method and a data joint optimization method are designed to solve the configuration problem of RFID system in practical application.

articleTitle: Intelligent Monitoring Method of Crude Fuel Images Based On Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The conditions of crude fuel can reflect the reaction degree in a blast furnace, and the real-time monitoring and analysis of the crude fuel can improve production performance and stabilize the conditions of the furnace. The results of crude fuel conditions obtained by traditional manual sampling detection are low in accuracy, and have danger and hysteresis. In order to reduce the workload of personnel and improve detection accuracy and timeliness, this paper proposes an intelligent monitoring method of crude fuel images based on deep learning. According to the method, attention mechanisms are added on the basis of a Mask R-CNN algorithm, so that the detection accuracy is improved, and besides, the problem of overfitting is solved. In order to ensure the detection accuracy under high-speed motion blurred images, a DeblurGAN-v2 algorithm is used to deblur the images; and when a dataset is built, data enhancement is used to increase the number and types of samples, so that the algorithm can adapt to the actual production environment of a factory. Through a crude fuel detection experiment, the effectiveness of the algorithm in the aspect of improving the detection accuracy of clear and blurred images is verified.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of printing pressure
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: To study the influence of blanket deformation on printing pressure in the printing process, and the problem that printing pressure is also undetermined. Method based on Hertz theory, we analyze the factors affecting printing pressure, build a cylinder test stand based on offset printing machine, and establish a rigid-flexible coupling dynamics model with blanket as a flexible body and other parts as rigid bodies based on rigid-flexible coupling theory, which can more accurately reflect the dynamic characteristics of the cylinder test stand and the dynamic excitation between printing cylinders.

articleTitle: Rapid Positioning Method of Civil Aircraft Assembly Scene Based on Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The assembly process of civil aircraft is complex and the amount of information is huge. When quality problems occur, the traceability of information investigation is low, especially for unstructured data such as images and videos. Manual positioning can range from hours to days. Therefore, solving the problem of information matching and rapid positioning of civil aircraft assembly scene can improve the efficiency of quality problem tracing and prevent the recurrence of the same problem in the production process. This paper proposes a vision-based method for information matching and rapid positioning of civil aircraft assembly scene. By uploading scene images, all the same or similar images can be quickly retrieved from the scene database. And the positioning experiment is carried out in the civil aircraft assembly production line and laboratory construction simulation scene. The positioning method proposed in this paper can locate the retrieval scene within 1 second, which has high positioning efficiency and high practicability.

articleTitle: Safety analysis of diesel hydrogenation unit based on a semi-quantitative risk assessment method
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: HAZOP analysis as a qualitative method can better identify the potential risks in the early design stage and in-service stage of the device. However, it is greatly influenced by the subjective factors of the appraisers during the assessment, which has a great impact on the accuracy and effectiveness of the risk assessment results. A semi quantitative compound risk assessment method (HALOPA method) is used to study the possible problems in the process flow and safety protection system of typical domestic diesel hydrogenation units. Taking the failure scenario of deoxygenated water pump as an example, the protective layer analysis method (HALOPA analysis) is adopted. On the basis of calculating the frequency of failure scenario and considering the acceptable risk standards of enterprises, the suggestions for improving the current independent safety protection layer and its safety integrity level (SIL) are put forward. The analysis results show that there are some shortcomings in existing process control, interlock protection, alarm setting and other protection measures of diesel hydro fining unit. The composite risk assessment method (HALOPA method) is of positive significance for effectively discovering and eliminating potential safety hazards in the operation process of the unit and ensuring safety in production.

articleTitle: High-speed automatic biochemical immune assembly line
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of medical technology, the application of automatic biochemical test technology is more and more extensive, users and the market put forward higher and higher requirements for the high speed, stability and accuracy of biochemical detection. This paper introduces a high-speed automatic biochemical immune assembly line with biosafety protection function, the assembly line uses a variety of technical means such as multi-channel transportation, superfine sample addition, ultrasonic blending, photon counter darkroom and biosafety protection, and it can realize the high-speed detection of biochemical items and also ensure the accuracy of detection results.

articleTitle: Ultrasonic beamforming algorithm based on deep learning and optimal model selection
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper proposes a method for ultrasonic beamforming based on deep neural network (DNN) with model selection based on contrast-to-noise ratio to suppress the degradation sources of image quality. The contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR), one of the image quality evaluation indicators, is combined with the loss function of fidelity in the network model to form a new loss function: CNR-LOSS, which is expected to improve the correlation between loss function and ultrasonic image quality. The training data comes from the ultrasonic simulation signals of cysts and point targets, and the input of DNN is the channel signal and its corresponding wavelet coefficients. DNN divides the parallel input into two types: on-axis signal and off-axis signal, and expects to retain only on-axis signal and clear off-axis scattering. In addition, the performance of DNN beamformer with and without CNR-LOSS is compared, and the effect of loss functions with different CNR weights on image quality is analyzed. Compared with the DNN beamformer without CNR-LOSS, DNN beamformer with CNR-LOSS and appropriate CNR weights achieves higher image quality in the experiment.

articleTitle: A Smooth and Time-Optimal Trajectory Planning Approach for Automated Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The discontinuity of jerk value of the traditional S-curve model seriously affects the accuracy and life of the equipment. To address such a problem, this paper proposes a smooth and time-optimal trajectory planning approach. Based on the piecewise trigonometric function, an infinitely differentiable jerk model and a parametric expression of the point-to-point programming algorithm based on this are proposed. The approach is simple in the calculation, can obtain analytical solutions, and can ensure the generated curve is smooth. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is verified through simulation.

articleTitle: Improved garment detection algorithm based on YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: An improved target detection algorithm based on YOLOv5 is proposed to address the problems of high similarity of existing clothing data, complex backgrounds, and low detection accuracy due to the difficult extraction of inter-class features. Based on the characteristics of the DeepFashion2 dataset, a new feature extraction layer with 64-times downsampling is designed, and a four-feature layer is used to detect larger clothing images; a lightweight GhostNet network is used instead of the backbone extraction network to reduce the network parameters and enhance the feature representation; Position information is incorporated into feature extraction to enhance the sensitivity of the model to position information;The experimental results show that compared with the original YOLOv5 network, the improved network models map50 and map50:95 are improved by 3.36% and 4. 7%, respectively, which can meet the practical application requirements of garment detection.

articleTitle: Cotton Packaging Defect Detection Based on Improved SVM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Because the traditional SVM detection algorithm was not accurate enough to detect the defects of cotton packaging and the recognition rate of small target defects was not high enough, an improved SVM algorithm was proposed to detect the five defects of cotton packaging, such as damage, stain, hole, impurity and thread end. By constructing the data set of damage, stain, hole, impurity and thread head, and on this basis, the data set was expanded by using data enhancement. By comparing several filtering methods, median filter was selected to preprocess the image, and OTSU threshold method was used to realize defect segmentation. Then, the entropy, contrast and inverse variance obtained by gray level co-occurrence matrix were used to extract the characteristics of cotton packaging defects, plus six eigenvalues of length, width and duty cycle. According to the intra class average distance DS of the same type of sample data and the inter class average distance of different types of sample data, calculated the separability depth measure of sample data I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">A, B</inf>, sorted the sample data, and detect defects according to the priority of labels. The experimental results showed that the overall recognition rate of the improved SVM algorithm for five kinds of defects in cotton packaging was 85.8%, and it can achieve good results for small target defects such as holes.

articleTitle: FAST Handling Robot Stiffness Analysis Based on Finite Element Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The robot described in this paper is used to transport the FAST feed receiver; its lifting part is a spatial multi-bar mechanism; in order to achieve accurate positioning in the transport and avoid deformation caused by large load and thus affecting the normal operation of the mechanism, the whole mechanism needs to have good stiffness. To analyze the stiffness of such complex mechanical mechanism, finite element method can be used for simulation. Based on Abaqus finite element software, the stresses and deformations of the handling robot, especially its lifting system, were analyzed under rated working conditions; the stresses and overall deformations of key parts of the lifting system were obtained. The analysis results showed that the maximum stress and deformation of the lifting system did not exceed the predefined targets. The obtained analysis results provide an important reference for the actual performance of the lifting system.

articleTitle: Study on the Smart Logistics Supply Chain Path for Smart Manufacturing Enterprises in the Post-Epidemic Era–––––Taking Dongguan BG Technology Co. as an Example
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The new crown epidemic sweeping the world has brought great challenges and uncertainties to the logistics supply chain of intelligent manufacturing enterprises. In the post-epidemic era where epidemic prevention is normalized, the traditional supply chain management of intelligent manufacturing enterprises relying on traditional labor, low informationization and low efficiency has revealed long material procurement cycle, serious information silos, difficulty in meeting customer delivery time, difficulty in improving efficiency and effectiveness, and high operation costs. The rise and development of smart supply chain provides an effective method and path for smart manufacturing to highly effect the rapidly uncertain changing logistics situation and the increasingly fierce international market competition. If smart manufacturing enterprises want to give full play to the potential and advantages of smart supply chain, they need to build a scientific, systematic and collaborative smart supply chain management system as a support. Based on this, the article proposes to build a networked, automated, digital and intelligent technology and management integrated system of smart supply chain for smart manufacturing enterprises to continuously improve the core competitiveness of the supply chain, and expects to provide some reference for smart manufacturing enterprises to quickly build a smart logistics system.

articleTitle: Estimation of near-surface NO2 based on TROPOMI and provincial control stations' data using machine learning
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Near-surface nitrogen dioxide NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> concentration is an essential indicator for ambient air quality monitoring. In this study, the extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) algorithm and random forest algorithm in machine learning are used to combine the TROPOspheric Monitoring Instrument(TROPOMI) high-resolution remote sensing images, meteorological and other auxiliary data with ground-level NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> concentration monitoring data (including national and provincial control stations) to construct a dataset of estimation samples and conduct research on estimating the near-surface NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> concentration on a grid with a spatial precision of 0.05° in Sichuan Province. According to the ten-fold cross-validation results of the test and training sets, the XGBoost model has better accuracy and generalization performance (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=0.875, RMSE=4.774 ug/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>), In addition, SHapley Additive exPlanation(SHAP) was employed after its development, which showed that TROPOMI satellite data contributed the most to the near-surface NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> estimation. By contrasting the results with the data set using only national control stations, we can see that after including the atmospheric monitoring data from provincial control stations, the estimated NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> concentration near the ground is more consistent with the data distribution of ground monitoring stations. Moreover, the spatial distribution of concentration is more continuous and homogeneous, providing essential support for local governments to regulate the atmospheric environment precisely.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a Numerical Control System for a Hybrid Machining Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Numerical control (NC) system is the core functional module of 5-axis machining devices. The paper presents a dispersing NC system for a novel hybrid machining robot. For this purpose., three issues are clarified., i.e. the architecture., the control strategy and the software of NC system. Firstly., by adopting a multi-axis motion control unit (MCU)., the architecture of a dispersing NC system is designed. Secondly., a control strategy is presented based on tool-path smooth algorithms., kinematics model and kinematic calibration method. By embedding above control strategy., a post-processing software and a human-machine interaction (HMI) software are developed. Finally., a NC system is developed to construct a hybrid machining robot system. A set of kinematic accuracy tests and machining tests are carried out to verify the feasibility of the developed NC system.

articleTitle: Fish Detection Based on Halcon and MobileNetV2 for Automatic Fish Feeding System
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Fish detection is an important technology to achieve intelligent, accurate and appropriate feeding of fish. The detection rate of traditional detection methods is low and the state of the fish school will have a certain impact on the accuracy of the feeding strategy. In order to improve the recognition rate and obtain the state of fish school, a low-resolution image fish detection method based on Halcon software and MobileNetV2 network is designed. The position coordinates and head orientation of fish are extracted to analyze the movement characteristics of fish school by MobileNetV2 network. The experimental results show that the detection method has a high recognition rate for fish detection. This method provides an important reference value for the design of automatic fish feeding system.

articleTitle: Optimization analysis of manufacturing process path of shift fork parts under the background of intelligent manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Intelligent manufacturing is the use of software to define the automatic flow of control data to solve the uncertainty of complex products. This paper taked the processing technology of lathe fork parts as the research object. The paper realized the optimization path of the forming process of the complex parts by comparing and analyzing the machining process and the additive manufacturing laser processing process. Through the lightweight design, it is concluded that aluminum alloy materials can be considered to replace cast iron materials to realize the optimized path of lathe fork parts in the direction of light weight. The results of this paper provide a feasible path reference for mapping complex product design and manufacturing from virtual space to physical space.

articleTitle: Design and manufacture of small off-road racing car for national Baja auto race
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The Baja Competition of China Society of Automotive Engineering has been held for six times since it was held in 2015. It is mainly for the design and production of small off-road vehicles carried out by vocational and undergraduate colleges. The competition requires each participating team to design and manufacture a single-seat, mid-engine, rear-drive small off-road vehicle using the same type of engine within the specified time, and participate in a number of static and dynamic project tests. This paper mainly introduces the design and manufacture process of two-drive Baja racing car, so that readers can better design and manufacture the parts of racing car, but also stimulate readers to choose more reasonable materials, trying to achieve a lighter, more stable, faster racing car. In this paper, the author put forward the car brake disc can be improved in what aspects, for readers to further explore independently. I hope this paper can help the students who participate in Baja auto competition and all the friends who are interested in car construction and car design.

articleTitle: Testability D Matrix Generation Method Based on Transitive Closure
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to effectively evaluate the testability level of equipment, identify and correct the testability design defects of equipment, so as to reduce the life cycle cost, a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$D$</tex> matrix generation method based on transitive closure is proposed. In this method, the relation matrix in the transitive closure theory is used to describe the fault propagation relationship between equipment functional modules, and the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$D$</tex> matrix is solved by analyzing the relationship between fault and test. Taking the radar transmitting subsystem as an example, the establishment process of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$D$</tex> matrix is explained. On this basis, the testability of the equipment is analyzed and the effectiveness of the method is verified.

articleTitle: State of Health Monitoring and Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Lithium-Ion Batteries Based on Integrated Model
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Accurately monitoring state of health and predicting remaining useful life play a significant role in the prognostic and health management of lithium-ion batteries. However, the prediction performance of some commonly used methods is poor due to the severe impacts of capacity regeneration and noise. This paper proposes a method that combines variational mode decomposition, temporal attention gated recurrent unit and temporal convolutional network for monitoring state of health and predicting remaining useful life of lithium-ion batteries. At first, the capacity sequence of the battery is multi-scale decomposed by using variational mode decomposition to acquire a residual and some capacity regeneration components. Next, the temporal attention gated recurrent unit and the temporal convolutional network are established to predict the residual and regeneration components of the capacity respectively. At last, the final prediction results of capacity and remaining useful life are obtained by integrating the prediction values of each component. The experimental results show that, compared to previous models, the integrated model is not only better able to capture the capacity regeneration, but also maintains excellent prediction performance at different prediction starting points.

articleTitle: Research on “Digital Quality Control” Method in Spacecraft Development Process
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Starting from the quality data of spacecraft development stage, this paper analyzes bottleneck problems that restrict the improvement of digital quality control ability, and conducts research from three aspects: innovative means and methods, reinforcing the basic network capability, and strengthening data mining analysis. It is proposed to improve the ability of obtaining basic data by establishing quality data acquisition system covering the whole production process; equipment interconnection, data sharing, and data accumulation are realized by establishing efficient physical network links and data centers, and opening up all system interfaces; add value to data assets by setting up spacecraft failure database. Finally, the quality information flow of the spacecraft production process can be fully connected, and data can be deeply mined and efficiently utilized.

articleTitle: Research of high-efficiency extraction of edges of large complex components in three-dimensional point clouds
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the rapid development of the automobile manufacturing industry, major automobile manufacturers around the world are stepping up digital transformation to achieve high-flexible, efficient and high-quality automobile production to adapt to the increasingly competitive market situation. Robots play an important role in automobile manufacturing. In the process of automobile manufacturing, the performance and quality of the product largely depend on the size accuracy of the parts, so edge information needs to be tested before the product is produced and assembled. At the same time, in the field of path planning, people need to obtain geometric feature information such as the edge of components in advance. However, large components are due to various the accuracy of the error needs to be scanned on the spot, and then processed after obtaining the point cloud. In this paper, a new method for quickly extracting edge contours from large-scale point clouds is studied. In the process of finding edges in two-dimensional images, some optimizations have also been made to make them more suitable for edge extraction of such plane structures. We also demonstrated the application of this method in a bus and compared it with two traditional methods.

articleTitle: Efficient Skeleton-Based Human Assembly Action Recognition Optimized by Data Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: As a new assembly model, human-robot collaborative assembly has attracted wide attention due to the diverse requirements of assembly tasks, complex shapes of assembly parts, and limited space in the current manufacturing industry. In the human-robot collaborative assembly environment of complex products, how to recognize human actions has become a key issue to better promote human-robot interaction. Firstly, considering the requirements of safety, efficiency, and accuracy in the human-robot collaborative assembly environment, we realize skeleton-based assembly action recognition. The channel-wise topology refinement graph convolution network (CTR-GCN) is utilized to extract the 3D skeletal features of the operator. In addition, considering the complexity of the assembly action dataset collection, we improve the recognition accuracy by data augmentation and find an appropriate training dataset size. Finally, in this paper, we focus on three assembly actions of the reducer and make an assembly action dataset in NTU RGB+D format. The optimization model based on data augmentation achieved high accuracy on the self-made assembly action dataset.

articleTitle: Design Optimization and Simulation Analysis of Screw Extrusion 3D Printing Screw
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of screw extruding 3D printing nozzle, such as easy blockage and insufficient extrusion force. In this study, a screw structure suitable for desktop metal 3D printing forming is designed, which can realize the miniaturization transformation from industrial level to desktop level. By establishing the three-dimensional solid model of the screw device and combining with the formula, the core structural parameters of the screw are analyzed. For the index of screw extrusion flow, the Taguchi Design Of Experiment (DOE) method was used to establish the L16(44) orthogonal test table for the optimal combination of factors. Simulation results show that the width and depth of the screw groove have the greatest effect on the extrusion flow; The optimal screw structure parameters: effective screw length L=60mm, slot width W=6mm, slot depth H=2mm and screw lead M=8mm. The velocity field, pressure field and shear stress field are better by the optimal combination of factors design.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of a high specific speed centrifugal pump
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: High specific speed centrifugal pumps as a general machine, high demands are placed on its performance and reliability. In this paper, Creo was used to model the fluid domain of the main flow components of the high specific speed centrifugal pump studied. In addition, ANSYS ICEM was used to divide the water mesh and verify the mesh independence. Ultimately, the appropriate number of meshes was found. Using ANSYS to calculate the constant value of high specific speed centrifugal pump under the large flow conditions and different number of blades. By comparing the simulation results with the experimental results, it is found that the difference between the overall trend of the simulation and the experimental data is within 5%. Therefore, the simulation is reasonable and effective.

articleTitle: Key technology for intelligent detection of colour defects in the clothing
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Along with the growing apparel industry, there is a growing demand for clothing. As the colour of clothing is the first impression consumers have of their clothes, it has become a technology being explored by clothing companies to effectively detect colour defects in real-time online. Traditional methods of detecting colour defects in clothing are usually performed manually and lack standard and automated tools. In this paper, we build on the YOLOv5 neural network algorithm for real-time online detection of garment colour defects and improve the YOLOv5 algorithm based on the fact that most garment colour defects are detected by small targets. The small target detection capability of YOLOv5 is further improved by introducing an attention mechanism and improving the loss function. The improved algorithm improves by 12.1% in terms of accuracy and 5.9% in terms of recall, which shows that the improved YOLOv5 algorithm is more effective in detecting the small targets commonly found in garment colour defect detection.

articleTitle: Design of sensor array data acquisition system based on equipotential method
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to reduce the measurement error caused by cross-talk of piezoresistive array flexible sensor and improve the accuracy of data acquisition, a cross-talk rejection circuit based on equal potential method is proposed, the data acquisition system is built, and the hardware and software of each module are designed. The experimental results show that the designed data acquisition system can basically eliminate crosstalk effect, carry out real-time data acquisition with good accuracy, and can transmit the measured data to the upper computer at the same time, to meet the requirements of piezoresistive array flexible sensor acquisition.

articleTitle: Automatic Door Control System of Ceramic Pipe Fitting Production Line Based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This research is based on the existing programmable logic controller (PLC), induction device, driving device and transmission device, to develop a convenient, multi-purpose, integrated automatic door control system for ceramic pipe fittings production line. With the growing development of industrial enterprises, for large industrial warehouses and production lines, in order to ensure the efficiency, reliability and security of goods storage and production, the intelligence of automatic doors in production lines is more important. The main working principle of the automatic door control system of the ceramic pipe fitting production line is that the sensing device sends the detected situation to the PLC, and the PLC makes a judgment based on the collected information, and then sends out the corresponding control signal to make the driving device run accordingly. Finally, the driving device drives the door to complete the task of automatic door control material transportation.

articleTitle: Force/PositionControl of Heterogeneous Teleoperation System Based on Adaptive Fuzzy& CMAC NN
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This study is mainly about the designation of a new type of Haptic Device and a new control algorithm on asymmetric teleoperation robots system. Aiming at the problems of tracking and transparency of the asymmetric teleoperation system, An new Adaptive Fuzzy & CMAC NN control algorithm was proposed. The Haptic Device was chosen as master-Robot of the system. Baxter dual-arm robot was chosen as slave-Robot of the system. The simulation experiment of Heterogeneous Teleoperation System Based on Adaptive Fuzzy & CMAC NN was carried out. The experiment results showed that the maximum values of displacement tracking errors in three directions x,y,z are 0.02m, 0.01m, 0.01m respectively. Compared with Adaptive Fuzzy control, the performance of the new control algorithm is improved. The force feedback experiment on real asymmetric teleoperation robot system was carried out. The results showed that the force feedback wave is consistent with the actual situation and showed that the Adaptive Fuzzy & CMAC NN control algorithm proposed is superior to Adaptive Fuzzy control algorithm. Therefore, the new algorithm perfectly satisfied the system. The experiment parameters also demonstrates the Haptic Device satisfies the design requirements of the asymmetric teleoperation robots system and the industry standards.

articleTitle: Study on the Characteristics of Multiway Valve with Compensator with Variable Pressure Difference
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The existing pre-valve pressure compensation flow control valve has the problems of low flow control accuracy, poor operating performance. In this regard, a load-sensitive flow valve with controllable pressure compensation ability is proposed, which improves the rapidity of large flow conditions and the energy saving and control accuracy of small flow conditions by ensuring that the pressure difference of the main valve is consistent with the change of pilot pressure. The working principle of variable pressure differential pressure compensation multi-way valve is clarified, and the simulation model of the multi-way valve is established on the AMESIM simulation platform for simulation analysis. The results show that when the compound movement requires a large flow, a wide range of no-flow saturation function can be achieved by increasing the pilot pressure, and the flow change curve is smooth in the whole process, and the whole machine runs without jitter, which has good controllability. When a small flow rate is required at low speeds, the pressure loss of the system is reduced by reducing the pressure drop, and the energy saving of the system is improved.

articleTitle: Autonomous generation method of robotic grinding program for large model-free complex forgings
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Large forging blank differ significantly from CAD models. Therefore, the CAD-based offline programming method cannot be utilized when robotic grinding is used, limiting the intelligent forging grinding upgrading process. To tackle this problem, this paper proposes an autonomous generation method of robot grinding programs without relying on CAD models. First, an improved K-means clustering algorithm based on point cloud Gaussian curvature is proposed to classify the original point cloud and obtain the sub-region boundary. Then, the auxiliary plane point cloud (APPC) construction law containing process information is established to generate the APPC clusters. Next, the robot grinding path points and grinding program are obtained through the intersection and thinning of the point cloud. Finally, simulations and experimental studies are performed to demonstrate that the method can generate executable grinding programs without using a standard CAD model. The results show that autonomous programming can significantly reduce program preparation time and achieve intelligent processing of model-free forgings.

articleTitle: Design of Direct ACC Unit Temperature Detection System Based on Energy-Harvesting Wireless Sensor Node
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: For detecting the temperature distribution of direct ACC unit more precisely, we have developed a temperature detecting system based on wireless sensor network. In the meantime, aiming at some disadvantages on existing power supply problem of sensor node, the new approach of collecting and converting environmental energy to supply power for low-power data acquisition nodes in system is used; establish the energy supply model based on TEG, which can greatly reduce the dependence of data acquisition nodes on batteries, the high cost of battery replacement and regular maintenance. Finally, it can significantly improve the sustainability and reliability of the whole wireless sensor network. which has clear practical engineering significance.

articleTitle: Design of Crawler Crane Simulation System Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In view of the current domestic large crane industry over-reliance on operator experience, do not have environmental recognition and intelligent control functions and other problems. In this paper, the use of digital twin technology can be a good solution to the physical space and information space blend with each other, and through the mapping of information in the virtual space to help physical entities better data monitoring and help operators to make decisions and other advantages, developed based on digital twin crawler crane simulation system. Through the 3D modeling of the crane and the model reduction, and then import game engine to complete the development of the simulation platform. The results show that the system runs stably and provides a new method for troubleshooting and danger elimination of crawler crane hoisting in complex environment.

articleTitle: Broadband Sound Insulation Performance of Composite Double Sandwich Panels with Periodic Piezoelectric Arrays
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper proposes an orthogonally rib-stiffened honeycomb double sandwich structure with periodic arrays of shunted piezoelectric patches, and the theoretical calculation model of the STL of the structure is established by using the space harmonic method and the virtual work principle, which provides a new idea for the design of lightweight sound insulation materials for aircraft cabins.

articleTitle: Analysis of manufacturing cost of large civil aircraft based on RBF neural networks
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: As a typical product of advanced manufacturing industry, civil aircraft is considered as high investment and high profit. Cost control of civil aircraft manufacturing is important for civil aircraft to occupy the market and achieve commercial success. This study aims to analyze manufacturing cost of large civil aircraft (with more than 150 seats), it analyzes and establishes an analysis model for the cost estimation based on RBF (Radial Basis Function) neural networks. RBF neural networks was studied theoretically and a model for manufacturing cost of large civil aircraft was established, data was collected, proceeded and input the model for desired results. Comparing the results out put from the model and the actual data, it showed that the error was acceptable and the model was accurate enough. On this basis, the model could be used for a civil aircraft manufacturer to estimate its manufacturing cost and make appropriate marketing plan for a new type of civil aircraft.

articleTitle: A Review and Comparison on Video Stabilization Alorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In recent years mobile phones and hand-held video cameras are gaining increasing popularity. They allow people to easily film videos but also bring unwanted camera shakes and jitters that affect the video quality. Although mechanical devices, optical devices, and electronic devices can help remove unwanted shakes, those methods are usually expensive and impractical for mobile phones and hand-held cameras. Whereas digital video stabilization techniques only require raw footage maybe plus the gyro data. In this paper, we focus on and compare the effects of different approaches to motion estimation and motion compensation, the two crucial parts of video stabilization algorithms that have a large impact on the quality of video stabilization. Based on that, we conclude that the future of video stabilization lies within using a gyroscope to get accurate camera motion and using neural networks to achieve amazing video quality.

articleTitle: The refactoring method about 3D model's horizontal profile for Additive manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Deal with the problem that direct contour of the cross-section in 3D model is discontinuous curvature. A kind of curve rebuilding method is proposed. Firstly, using the location relationships between the section and the model solve the crossover points. Then, using high interpolation function fits those points to get the section-profile's fitting curve. Finally, analysis the error of the fitted curve. Resolutely, using this curve to replacement the direct curve is accurate in AM. In the same time, this method can solve the problem that direct contour is discontinuous.

articleTitle: Dynamic Modelling and Analysis of a Novel Redundantly Actuated Parallel Spindle Head
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Dynamic modelling and analysis are the basis for precise control of mechanical devices. The present aims to provide a dynamic modelling methodology for redundantly actuated parallel spindle head. For this purpose, a novel redundantly actuated parallel spindle head is taken as an example to demonstrate the modelling process. Firstly, the structure of novel redundantly actuated parallel spindle head is described to reveal its topology of 2PRU &(2PRU)R parallel mechanism. Secondly, a close-loop-based kinematic model is constructed to provide kinematic foundation for further dynamic modelling. Thirdly, a comprehensive dynamic model is established by using the principle of virtual work. Based on the established model, the actuated forces are predicted and further optimized by the least 2-norm criterion. Finally, some numerical simulations are carried out to verify the proposed dynamic modelling methodology. The good agreement between the theoretical and numerical results proves the effectiveness of the proposed dynamic model.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Group of Cooperative Robots
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In a specific scene, a group of robots is required, which can start from a certain place, reach a designated location, take high objects, and then safely transport them to a designated location. Based on the research status at home and abroad, this paper proposes a software and hardware system design scheme, which has been verified by practice, can not only accurately complete the collaborative retrieval task, but also safely deliver to the destination in a short time. The robot design in this paper needs ingenious mechanical structure design and good operation cooperation of the robot.

articleTitle: Reliability optimization for load-sharing systems with exponentially distributed units
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The load-sharing system is a class of redundant technology that allocate the total load to all surviving units, which can effectively improve the quality and reliability of the system. The units of the load-sharing system are dependent because of the load sharing mechanism, and the most popular load allocation strategy is equal load allocation strategy. However, the units of the load-sharing system are not always in the same reliability level, and equal load allocation strategy may not lead to the highest system reliability in this case. Confronted with this problem, this paper proposes a new load allocation strategy based on the practical lifetime characteristics of the units. The studied load-sharing system consists of two or three exponentially distributed units. Reliability models for these two kinds of systems are developed theoretically and numerically. Simulation results show that the proposed load-sharing strategy can greatly improve the system reliability.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Network for Real-Time Target Semantic Segmentation Based on Dual Paths
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: High-precision extraction of target features is a challenge in real-time image analysis. Contemporary real-time semantic segmentation methods sacrifice segmentation accuracy to meet the high inference speed, resulting in poor model performance. Therefore., in order to achieve the best segmentation accuracy and reasoning speed as possible., based on the biseNet network structure., this paper uses the pre training model mobilenet to preliminarily extract image features., and replaces the spatial path with ASPP(Atrous spatial pyramid pooling)., increasing the receptive field and improving the ability to obtain global information. The experimental results show that the method has good performance on the data set made by collecting the images of butt welds in the process of argon arc welding of thin-walled stainless steel pipes., and the detection speed reaches 55 FPS., which fully meets the requirements of real-time segmentation.

articleTitle: Surface Defect Detection of Parts Based on the YOLOv5 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper is a research on surface defect detection of parts based on the YOLOv5 algorithm. Usually, the detection of elements defects is based on human eye observation, and inspectors can identify the weaknesses of elements one by one.Still,the efficiency and accuracy of detection are relatively low, and there may be missed detection and wrong detection. Nor can the testing standards of inspectors be completely uniform. Therefore, the loss function of the Head part of the output of the original YOLOv5 algorithm is improved, so that the average accuracy average is increased by 5.2%, the accuracy and recall rate are also improved. The efficiency and accuracy of part detection are improved, indicating that the improved algorithm meets the production needs, saves a lot of labor costs, and improves the efficiency of the enterprise.

articleTitle: A mobile robot repositioning method combining vision and laser
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The laser sensor information is single, the perceptual feedback dimension is low, and the feedback information is lack in the open outdoor scene and the scene with similar geometric features, which makes it difficult to complete the positioning and navigation work. The visual positioning is easily interfered by light, and the accuracy is limited by the algorithm. Combining the advantages and disadvantages of the two methods, an algorithm combining vision and laser repositioning is proposed. Firstly, vision is based on ORB feature matching to do the preliminary localization, and an artificial bird swarm algorithm is proposed to improve the accuracy of local localization when the prior location is known. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm shortens the relocation time by one order of magnitude compared with the pure laser localization algorithm, and improves the localization accuracy by one order of magnitude compared with the pure vision algorithm.

articleTitle: Improving the Performance of Fast Steering Mirror Based on Kalman Filter and Fuzzy PI Control
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this paper, a compound control system of fast steering mirror based on fuzzy adaptive PI and Kalman filter is designed. Based on MATLAB/Simulink software simulation experiment, the designed control system is compared with traditional PI controller and digital low-pass filter respectively. The experimental results show that it greatly improves the adaptive ability and anti noise ability of the system. The filtered curve also has no obvious phase lag.

articleTitle: Development of a power line Inspection Robot Capable of automatically crossing Obstacles
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: According to the characteristics of the transmission line environment and the requirements of the inspection task, a robot mechanism for inspection based on the transformation of the transmission line is proposed. The configuration of the robot and the magnetic online charging device are analyzed. The obstacle surmounting process of typical obstacles is analyzed by using finite state machine. The motion sequence of the robot crossing obstacles is planned and the obstacle crossing test is carried out. The test results show that the mechanism can cross the drainage line, tension clamp and other complex obstacles, which verifies the rationality of the mechanism design and the feasibility of the motion planning. With the transformation of the transmission line environment, the robot can efficiently and quickly cross the typical obstacles.

articleTitle: Design of Referee System for Competition Based on Wireless Sensors Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the current scoring process of robot competition in primary and secondary schools, most of them use manual referees, resulting in insufficient fairness in the competition, waste of human and material resources and other problems. In this paper, sensor technology is used to detect the running position information and related parameters of the competition robot, LoRa wireless communication technology is used to realize the signal transmission between the signal acquisition equipment and the gateway, and the upper computer software is designed to display the score and complete the record, which makes up for the shortcomings of manual scoring in the competition. The experimental results show that the system has high stability, fast scoring speed, and can complete the automatic timing and scoring of robot competitions, automatically feedback the completion of robot tasks and judge the scores according to the completion of tasks.

articleTitle: Simulation of thin-walled cylindrical parts assembly under ship oscillation
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Swaying is the main factor restricting the precision docking of shipboard thin-walled parts. Aiming at the assembly error analysis problem of thin-walled cylindrical parts under ship oscillation, this paper presents a simulation analysis method of butt surface center error based on finite element analysis and dynamic analysis. The method integrates the control performance of the electromechanical system, the dynamic deformation of the structure and the transmission clearance. In swaying environment, establishing the simulation model of cylinder parts docking test system based on Stewart platform. Based on finite element analysis and dynamic simulation, the safety characteristics of the system are verified and the center error of the docking surface is calculated. The results show that the center error of the test system docking is 0.75mm when the ship roll amplitude is 6.25° and 2.5°. And the effectiveness of this error analysis method is verified by comparing the simulation and test results of the test system in gravity environment.

articleTitle: Principle and Common Fault Analysis of Hydraulic System of YT4543 Power Sliding Table
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this paper, the working principle of the hydraulic system of the power sliding table of the modular machine tool YT4543 is analyzed. The common fault phenomena of the system are analyzed and specific improvement measures are put forward, which is of great significance to reduce and avoid hydraulic failure. It helps the system run better and stably, and improves the equipment utilization rate.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis of Surface Ship Hull Thin Section Lifting Scheme
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problems that the deformation of the thin plate segments of surface ships may damage the internal structure or lead to the inability to lift and close the ship, taking three typical thin plate segments of a ship as an example, the corresponding lifting plan is designed, the factors affecting the construction efficiency of the lifting equipment on the whole process of lifting them are discussed, the deformation of the three thin plate segments under different working conditions is calculated by using the finite element analysis method, and the temporary strengthening plan is proposed for the segments with oversized deformation. temporary strengthening scheme. The results show that the lifting solution is suitable for the weak structural strength of the thin plate segments of the hull and meets the requirements of the classification society lifting code, thus making the lifting operation of the thin plate segments of the ship hull more convenient and efficient.

articleTitle: Multimodal Disinformation Detection with Joint Propagation Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The spread of disinformation can easily bring serious consequences for society. This means the detection of disinformation cannot be ignored. Current research on multimodal disinformation detection tends to ignore the influence of propagation structure. Therefore, this paper proposes a multimodal disinformation detection method based on text, images and the propagation structure, which learns new text structure features from a heterogeneous graphical model based on global-local relationships and then splices the new text structure features with traditional text auxiliary features. Finally, the picture features are combined with the text features obtained after the splicing to obtain the multimodal joint representation. The experimental results show that our model has higher accuracy and stronger generalization ability compared with the related multimodal models on the microblogging dataset.

articleTitle: Design and Experiment of a Novel Manipulator for Autonomous Harvesting Tomato Clusters
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: A cherry tomato picking robot manipulator was designed for greenhouse cherry tomato harvesting in bunches. The manipulator consists of an end-effector and its control system which adopts the “bottom-up” enveloping fruit harvesting method to complete the shearing and clamping of the fruit stems of the fruit bunches to realize the bunch picking operation of cherry tomatoes. The end-effector adopts a gearing - five-link mechanism, and the structural parameters are designed using the analytical method with length and envelope constraints. The structural parameters are optimized by analyzing the mechanical properties of fruit stalk shearing and the shearing and clamping motion process of the gear-five-link mechanism. The experimental results showed that the fruit envelope success rate of the end-effector of the string tomato picking robot was 92%, the picking success rate was 87%, the fruit damage rate was 7%, and the average picking time was 10.43s per string.

articleTitle: Smoke Gas Leakage Calculation and Data Analysis of Lift Landing Door Fire Resistance Test
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The elevator landing door is one of the special equipment components that have the closest contact with the public. It is an important physical barrier that separates the floors from the hoistway. In the event of a fire in a high-rise building, complete lift landing doors play an important role in preventing the spread of toxic fumes across floors. It is not an easy task to test and determine the smoke blocking ability of lift landing doors under fire conditions. Generally, the combustion test furnace and the collection and measurement of specific gas (CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) are used to estimate the amount of smoke gas leakage. In this paper, a burner and gas (CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) collection system for lift landing doors were built, the calculation formula of flue gas leakage suited for the integrity of lift landing doors was deduced, the differences in the results of processing smoke gas leakage with multiple mathematical method steps was described. Then, the test results of smoke leakage from lift landing doors without fire-resistant design and with three fire-resistant measures were analyzed. Finally, some design suggestions for improving the fire-resistance integrity of lift landing doors were put forward.

articleTitle: Control and Visualization of 3D Pipe Model Based on OpenGL
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In view of the limited production caused by the long debugging period of the pipe bending machine, it is necessary to develop a 3D pipe model display system to assist the technical personnel to debug the pipe bending machine. Because OpenGL technology has the advanced ability of modeling, illumination, transformation and color processing, it can reduce the development cost of pipe bending machine. Therefore, this paper takes 3D pipe fittings as the research object, uses OpenGL technology and Visual C++ programming language to develop a 3D pipe fitting model display system, and realizes the visualization of 3D pipe fitting model. In order to reduce the workload, the model is established by professional 3D modeling software 3DS MAX software, and then rendered and controlled by OpenGL technology. The results show that the real-time rendering of the 3D model observation imaging rendering and good human-computer interaction control function can be realized.

articleTitle: Path Planning of Mobile Robot Based on Improved A* Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Path planning technology is the core part of the independent navigation of mobile robots. The problem of unscrupulous road planning and many turning point nodes need to be resolved. In response to the problem of traditional A* algorithm expansion nodes, long search time, and excessive path bending, an improvement A* algorithm that uses an inspiration function optimization and cubic Bezier curve optimization. Based on the ROS open-source system, the Gazebo physical simulation environment is built, and the practical Gmapping builds a grid map. The improved algorithm before and after the improvement is used as a global path planner plugin and applied to ROS for simulation experiments. The simulation results show that in the same simulation experimental environment, the length of the improved A* algorithm path is reduced by 17.161%, and the number of redundant turning nodes is reduced by 71.429%; More reasonable, further meet the constraints of mobile robots.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of the Picking Roll of the Corn Harvester
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The header is the most important part of the corn harvest, and the structure of the stripping roller determines the results of stripping and stalk pulling. In order to improve the efficiency and integrity of harvesting, a new type of harvesting roller was designed. Based on the working principle of the snapping roll, the spiral round steel and the snapping claw are welded on the body of the snapping roll in the way of straw feeding and entering the snapping roll under the action of the grain divider. In order to verify the rationality, the snapping roll was simulated to verify the rationality of the structure design.

articleTitle: Garment Pattern Recognition Method based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper takes the dress pattern diagram as the research object, adopts the machine vision recognition method, simulates the process of pattern maker interpreting the pattern diagram, quantifies the characteristics of the dress pattern diagram, constructs a set of automatic recognition systems of dress pattern diagram, and realizes the rapid recognition of dress pattern diagram and the output of intelligent board information. The system will solve the problem of upgrading the labor cost of the traditional clothing industry to a certain extent, improve the production efficiency of flexible manufacturing, reduce the production cost, and adapt to the innovation of the clothing industry under the environment of big network data.

articleTitle: An Improved Ant Colony Algorithm Based Dynamic Sorting Strategy: Application to Delta Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to improve the speed, efficiency and robustness of the automatic sorting system, this paper proposes an improved ant colony algorithm based dynamic sorting strategy. Under the operating condition of automatic sorting scenario on the assembly line, two city sets are established to divide the picking area and the placing area as two countries. In addition, an improved ant colony algorithm optimization approach with variation operator is added, which get inspired by genetic algorithms. This optimization approach has the properties of broad adaptability, high feasibility and capability to achieve global optimization. Simulation and experimental results show that the proposed sorting strategy has better robustness for sorting operations with different objects density. Meanwhile, it can effectively reduce the sorting path length and working time compared with traditional sorting strategies.

articleTitle: Toward Kinematic Control for Redundant Manipulators with Flexibility Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a robot motion control method based on operability optimization. For cooperative robots with redundant degrees of freedom and even super redundant robots (such as elephant nose robots), in the process of motion control, we focus not only on how to achieve the trajectory tracking of the end, but also on how to use the redundant degrees of freedom of the system to make the robot work in a better position. In this process, manipulability is an important representation of robot flexibility. We first construct the angular acceleration satisfying the convergence of terminal error, and then design the acceleration component that can optimize the kinetic energy of the system in the zero space of the robot. The control variables of the system are obtained based on the calculated torque method. Numerical simulation shows the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Selection of Heat Dissipation Devices for Photovoltaic Power Generation Module based on Cluster Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper studies the selection of a heat dissipation device based on a photovoltaic power generation module. All countries are currently carrying out photovoltaic power generation projects to solve the problem of heat dissipation in photovoltaic power generation, which is very important. In this paper, the k clustering algorithm of artificial intelligence is established. Then the selection of appropriate materials is analyzed through cluster analysis so that the decision is more optimized, and the specific structure and material selection of photovoltaic devices are designed. We consider the fin structure and study the influence of different fin structures in different environments. Finally, the simulation results show that the heat dissipation coefficient of the sawtooth fin is significantly higher than that of the other fin structures in the high Reynolds number region.

Author Keywords: Convection and heat transfer criterion equation

articleTitle: Modeling of manufacturing resources towards an interactive Resource Social Network
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The rapidly changing market has stimulated the emergence of self-organizing mechanisms in intelligent manufacturing systems, where resources are generally capable of making decisions through intercommunications and interoperations to maximize system adaptivity. With the increasing number of exceptional events during manufacturing, those mechanisms might eventually fail to react timely to situations of multiple resource conflicts. In this work, we discussed the social networks consisting of various manufacturing resources and provided the relevant modeling techniques including the Resource Description Framework and the Finite State Machine. The function and behavior models can support the autonomous interactions and collaborations among resources, while the communication hub connected the resources and formed a peer-to-peer network. On this basis, the dynamic features of manufacturing networks including the exception propagation phenomenon can be analyzed. A case was studied to identify the bottleneck resources using the complex network theory. This work has provided an analytical platform to optimize manufacturing resources using complex network and graph theory.

articleTitle: Design and Research of 5 DOF Material Handling Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Robots have the characteristics of perception, decision-making and execution, and are widely used in manufacturing. In practical production, mobile robots are increasingly widely used as the main part of material handling robots. Based on these reasons, this paper designs the 5 DOF material handling robot. The robot is loaded with Cortex-M3 kernel, which is composed of patrol module, mobile module, multifunctional module, task setting and image recognition. The tracking differentiator and PID algorithm are used for the velocity planning and control adjustment to improve movement stability and control accuracy of the robot. The experimental results show that the robot can complete the functions of autonomous patrol, material clamping and handling, task acquisition, color recognition and information display. It has the characteristics of small size, material grabbing, high degree of automation and simple maintenance. Its diversified functions can meet the dangerous and heavy handling tasks in production, and its high automation level can improve production efficiency.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Production Scheduling Method for Decommissioned Power Battery Dismantling Workshop Based on Segmental Strategy
publicationTitle: 2022 5th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Unlike the forward assembly process, it difficult to achieve efficient scheduling of the production of disassemble production because most of retired power batteries are deformed. In this paper, a multi-objective production scheduling method for retired power battery disassembly workshop is proposed. Firstly, a segmented scheduling strategy based on two stages of battery pack and module is designed, then a multi-objective optimal scheduling model of disassembly workshop is established. The multi-objectives are reducing the completion time, energy consumption and equipment load. Finally, a genetic algorithm is used to solve it, and the chromosome coding method, cross-variation method and elite retention strategy in the genetic algorithm are optimized.
